117003.description:
Lee Yoori, an employee of the EG Department Store HR team, and Lee Yool, the youngest daughter of the EG Group President, fell from the 10th floor building. Lee Yoori, surprised, woke up in Lee Yool body. But Lee Yoori believes that one day their bodies will return to normal. Lee Yoori will live her life as a daughter of a conglomerate. But the thing is, Lee Yool has a fiance and they're going to be married soon! Will Lee Yoori successfully overcome all obstacles as a daughter of a millionaire?!

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

117004.description:
Aoi Nemo is a big-ticket businessman whose face has appeared on all the magazines, and there's a price on his head. Coming to collect is Akaumi Kiruru, an assassin as deadly as she is beautiful. But the person who requested the hit was Aoi himself! From the moment he laid eyes on her, Aoi fell for this femme fatale, and he'll do whatever it takes to spend more time with her: even if it means risking his own life. Don't miss this zany comedy about losing your head over love!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

117039.description:
An angel made a mistake, resulting in Shiihara Daiki’s death. In order to hide the mistake, he was then sent to a different world. The angel will grant him one wish as a payment for keeping it a secret. Daiki asked for a Heavenly Castle floating in the sky without hesitation.

Suddenly a floating castle appeared in the new world, which causes confusion amongst the people. They attempt to contact Daiki in various ways. A country tries to steal it by force, while another seeks to befriend him. What in the world would Daiki do?

117040.description:
Suddenly appearing in a different world, it looks like I got caught up in a Hero Summoning. And of course, I’m not the Hero, but it’s another guy……and while being very cautious and scared of the cliche-like development, I was thrown into the maelstrom of war……or not.

The Demon Lord? It was defeated a thousand years ago. Hero? He’s just the main actor in a festival. Nobles? They’re kindly taking care of us. The Demon Race? They have good relationships with Humans. Wars? It’s already 800 years since the last one. Monsters? The Guild and Order of Knight are taking care of them. Return to Earth? It is essentially No-Risk.

What I’m planning after being caught up into this? I’m gonna enjoy the life in a different world as much as I want to, go on a cultural exchange and sightseeing, and after experiencing the festival that is only held once every ten years……I shall go home safely.
synonyms: I Was Caught up in a Hero Summoning, but That World Is at Peace

117044.description:
Masaru is an ordinary middle-aged guy who does construction work on convenience stores and home centers and whatnot.
Do I really need to give you the rest? Reincarnated in a young body, bunch of low-quality skills but are good for his own profession, decides to do construction again, girls with rabbit ears, slow life. You know what you were getting into the minute you saw “Home Center Isekai” in the title, so why are you still reading this and forcing me to write another synopsis for an isekai with the same plot beats as the last three?

117047.description:
It has been more than ten years since he was transported to another world. The protagonist Deris Fahrenheit, who has became a magician with special circumstances, was freely enjoying his life in this world. However, a girl appeared before him and asked him to make her his disciple. That girl seems to be a transported person――

It’s a story of him who becomes the girl’s teacher and trains her to achieve her revenge (?) in otherworld.

117048.description:
Ready for Anything—Except This

​Strapped for cash, Souya signs up for a shady gig straight out of a video game: warp to a fantasy world with a team of experts and ascend a dungeon tower to make off with its spoils. However, an accident in the transfer process leaves him stranded there alone. Desperate for support, he recruits a host of adventurers—from elven sisters banished from their forest, to a Goddess of Deception and Secrecy partial to lazing about as a cat—to form a party that can brave the tower’s perils. Caught between corrupt nobles and merchants outside the dungeon and deadly monsters within, can this motley band rise to the challenge? Or will Souya’s adventure end before it even begins?

(Source: Yen Press)

117049.description:
One day, Sayaka finds a banana on the street, which is summarily consumed by a loitering Yoshiko. Later that night, Sayaka is visited by the spirit of the banana, who transforms her into an angel and tasks her to go help souls in need. She eventually winds up at A-kun's house, where she now has to grant his true heart's desire... to marry Sayaka? Find out just what on earth is going on in this parody spin-off to Hiroyuki's wildly popular Aho Girl series!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

117051.description: Cid is a boy who reincarnated in another world, and decided to enjoy a scenario of being "the eminence in shadow, someone who meddles with the story from the shadows, and exhibits his true power in secrecy". Thus unfolds the story of him and the secret organization he leads—shadow garden—as well their their pleasant friends! An easy-going 4-koma manga starts right here and now!

title.native: 陰の実力者になりたくて！ しゃどーがいでん
title.romaji: Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!: Shadow Gaiden

117052.description:
Scaredy-cat Shinji Takasaki gets forced to take a picture in the science room after school as part of a punishment game, where he comes across the self-proclaimed ghost Sagara. Sagara, who tells Shinji he's "interested" in him, says he'll curse him if he doesn't come back to visit the science room. The more time they spend together, the less Shinji feels like he was forced to be there... But ghosts like Sagara have to move on eventually, so how long can they keep this up?

(Source: Futekiya)

1-3. Houkago no Ghost (放課後のゴースト, Ghost After School)
4-5. D-tou Danshi Toire (D棟男子トイレ, D-Block Boy's Toilet)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

117053.description:
Anri Kajimi is a junior-high boy who loves Insects so much that he doesn't have any human friends. One day, he suddenly found a naked girl in his house. She told him her name is Makiri Oka, and that she is a Konchuki (insect girl), with a mix of human and insect characteristics. And that she had come from 100 years in the future to fulfill Anri's wish. And that wish is for "Anri to mate with me"…

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

117054.description:
Chitose is a high school baseball player who had to abandon baseball due to injury.
One day, when Chitose was spending a boring day off without any goal, Chitose's life changed completely with a "VRMMO game" that was suddenly sent by his sister Haruka! “Oy Onii-chan, let's play a game together in our spare time!”

A high school baseball player became a gamer at the invitation of his cute sister! ? Using his "excellent baseball sense" to enjoy a fun game in a VR world!

title.native: 廃ゲーマーな妹と始めるVRMMO生活
title.romaji: Hai Gamer na Imouto to Hajimeru VRMMO Seikatsu

117055.description: A Japanese person reincarnated into an Otome game chok full of death flags for the villainess, Rosalind. "I'm going to live an enjoyable life in this world!" Making full use of the game knowledge to avoid death flags, for some reason events keep happening one after another?! Contracting with spirits, helping her father (the prime minister) with his work using her modern day knowledge, taking a walk with the holy beast... and on top of all that, even starting up the heroine's event...? Will Rosalind be able to smash through every unknown death flag that comes her way...?! And will she be able to be fluffy lovey dovey with the supporting beastkin character she liked from her previous life?!?!
synonyms: I Won't Become a Villainess. I'm Just a "Normal" Duke's Daughter!

117056.description:
A punk girl turns into a great goddess to beat up scumbags and oppress fake angels. She angers all of the surrounding rotten women to death.

After being reborn, I, Chi Yan, have to marry this brainless playboy with X disease? I found a handsome man to play my boyfriend, but he ended up trying to flirt with me every day!

An icy chairman announced: My Yan'Er is the cutest in the world. I won't hold her back!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Cute Wife of the Cold Chairman

title.english: The Icy Chairman's Cute Little Wife

117058.description:
Marie is a new attendant at the nursing home for retired adventurers. She's actually the grand-daughter of the defeated Demon Lord, seeking to exact revenge. But watch out, looking after senile adventurers can be just as dangerous as fighting them on the front lines!

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

117059.description:
Does love make you blind? Not just blind! A story about a workplace romance and a girl who's obviously in love!

Contrary to the saying, "Love makes you beautiful," Sa-ae has a lot of tension to show to the other person. Kim Nam-joo, a childhood friend, gets confided in the agency after joining the company and gets treated for minor ailments. But Nam Joo doesn't like this agent who doesn't cherish each other... To make matters worse, Sa-ae finds out about her sloppy secret love affair from her boss, Shin.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated & edited)

117060.description: A male science teacher and a female school nurse at a local school live in the same apartment building. Sometimes she visits his room and they drink together. A situation arises that causes some awkwardness in their relationship. Will they be able to resolve things?

117061.description:
Delve deeper into Kirito's and Asuna's pasts in this collection of three short stories adapted to manga for the first time! From their newlywed life in SAO to Asuna's time in ALO, revisit events from throughout the series as they originally appeared in the novels!

(Source: Yen Press)

The modern cultivation world has become a place of intrigue and calculation. The strong prey on the weak. Everyone feels insecure. The security guard, Hero Ma, started his cultivation by accident after he saved a girl cultivator...

(Source: Webnovel)

117064.description: In one particular town in France, a waiter who feels like he’s stuck at the bottom of the sea meets a free-spirited pâtissier. Across the world, on a frozen tundra, a boy searching for his father meets a scientist and a man with the look of a snowy owl.

Wanna step on a landmine girl!!?

(Source: fakku)

117068.description:
A pervert with great martial arts skills, a klutz of a nun, a dojo master with a bombastic imagination, a chivalrous but capricious Taoist, a mentally unstable patient who carelessly exudes internal energy… And so many experts who’re castrated? Hehe—So this is Murim?!

The hot-blooded high school boy, the mysterious female swordswoman from the Blade and the capricious black hearted girl make you unable to tell the reality from the game world! What plots were waiting for them? Please enjoy the story in Being the Reality.

117073.description:
The newest diary manga from the Harvey Award-winning creator of My Lesbian Experience with Loneliness.

Nagata Kabi’s groundbreaking autobiographical work has captivated audiences around the globe, starting with the viral online comic about identity that would become the graphic novel My Lesbian Experience with Loneliness. Readers from all backgrounds have been moved by the author’s ability to capture complex emotions through her art and text, giving insight into feelings they may have struggled to articulate themselves. Nagata Kabi’s memoirs, including the Eisner-nominated My Solo Exchange Diary and new release My Alcoholic Escape From Reality, have explored themes of physical and mental illness, sex and sexuality, family, and independence. Follow the newest installment of this trailblazing series with My Wandering Warrior Existence, Nagata Kabi’s exploration of longing for love and marriage.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Diario di una guerriera single - Il mio matrimonio con me stessa

117075.description:
The manga will focus on the future lives of the story's "pets," in particular Hiroki, Tsukasa, and Satoru.

(Source: Anime News Network)

117077.description:
One night after leaving a club where he was playing trumpet Ryou Takagi is jumped by a motorcycle gang. The scuffle spills out into the streets and causes a traffic accident. Because of this, Ryou is arrested and forced to do time. Upon his release, he has developed into a skilled boxer but trouble continues to find him.

Note: B.B won the Shogakukan Manga Award in the shounen category in 1989.

117078.description: The world’s first action game VRMMO FWO (Fantasy World Online). Our main character chose to become a Summoner. While not so much in particularly willing to go about aggressively capturing monsters or aim to be the strongest player. Just wanting to have an adventure to search for cute monsters and clothes’ material. Without noticing in the flow of one situation after another, he becomes the top ranking Summoner.
synonyms: I Started As Summoner In VRMMO

title.native: VRMMOでサモナー始めました

117079.description: Because of their evil deeds, the Four Perils had their bodies sealed in a rocky mountain. After the death of Maomei's grandfather, they make their return. Having mistakenly swallowed the magatama that contained their power when she was little, she becomes their target.

117080.description:
Exams can be life-changing. Failing one just ended Allen's promising career at the royal court before it began. Now, to make ends meet, the lowborn sorcerer must help one of the kingdom's highest-born young ladies pass hers.

Duke Howard's daughter Tina has a brilliant mind, but the prestigious Royal Academy demands magic. Try as she might, she can't cast a single spell, and her impairment has baffled the kingdom's finest minds for years. With the all-important entrance exams just three months away, Allen and his unorthodox brand of spellcasting seem like her last hope to realize her dream of learning sorcery in the capital. So why does her father, the duke, want the young tutor to dash her dreams instead?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Tutor of the His Imperial Highness princess

title.english: Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter

117084.description:
Kousuke Kurono has finally taken revenge on his sister's murderer. Having no more regrets and nothing more to live for, Kurono took his own life. However, he found himself reincarnated to another world that only those with a tragic past can visit. Kurono was confused, but then he realized that his sister may have come to this world as well. With mixed feelings, he set out to look for her......

(Source: GC Novels, translated)

title.romaji: Fukushuu Kansuisha no Jinsei Nishuume Isekaitan

117088.description:
College student Hadam desperately needs a recommendation letter from her professor. The only way to get it? Be a mentor to an exchange student and house them for a full semester. Hadam was expecting a female, but the exchange student turns out to be… a handsome French male?! What will happen when Hadam has to live with him under the same roof? Will they be able to overcome the language barrier to find love?

(Source: Manta)

117090.description: Sousuke's lust for women is too much, so he's transferred to a high school in the country. While staying with his aunt, he encounters his first love, his cousin Minori-chan. However, it's his first time seeing them in 11 years, and come to find out, his beloved Minori-chan is a man...and a teacher at his school! His world comes crashing down, but just when he's about to give up, he witnesses Minori doing...lewd things to himself?!

117093.description:
The last surviving omega, and the man who desperately needs him! Fifty years go, a virus sweeps through the world, wiping out all the omegas from the face of the earth. Rain, the sole surviving omega, lives his whole life hiding his identity - until he accidentally runs into Lukas. As the chairman of the facility that used to produce artificial omegas, Lukas has to produce an alpha heir in order to succeed his father's business. And while he has his mind set on winning Rain over, things don't seem to go so smoothly...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

117094.description: Left alone in front of the monastery during a troublesome time, Yub SeJun was thought to be a normal, abandoned baby. However, he had the power to change the world in the way he wanted. In the world, everyone followed the classical cultivation; however, SeJun follows his morals and creates a novel cultivation method. Can he become the new hero who will bring the world out of chaos?

117099.description: DoEun, the leader of the loyalist party and serial-dater, has a new mission. In order to infiltrate the house of the country's enemy, Seo MoonTaek, DoEun approaches JangHan, MoonTaek's son, but..."What? A romantic relationship regardless of gender?" Jiang Jiusi, a strong female general, woke up to find that she had changed into a beautiful woman. Faced with the emperor's favor, she only wants to fight on the battlefield, defending the country. But she is not as strong as she used to be; so how could she possibly fight?

117101.description:
Luo Qingtong, a young lady from the 24th century who ranked first among those with superpowers, miraculously transmigrated into a different world. There, she begins her journey of vengeance as the crippled, oldest daughter of a duke from the lower kingdoms, where villains line up to get face-slapped and scumbags and manipulative bitches wait to get tortured!

An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. She'll exterminate anyone who offends her! All is going well... but then she accidentally gets involved with a man of peerless beauty, whom she attempts to flirt with whenever she's unable to win against him in a fight. From there on, it becomes a story about their romantic pursuits..."

Upon praying to god to grace them with a child, an infertile couple receives a child no larger than an inch tall! Afterwards, he is inexplicably chased by people dressed in black who are intent on taking his life. Bai XiaoShu follows his father’s instructions and returns to his family residence. Determined to sow despair and destruction across the land, she… Wait, what kind of a rotten future is that?! Tsuya comes to Tokyo to hire popular music producer Chihiro Kuno to write some songs for his group of small-town pop stars back home, but he certainly didn’t expect to be pushed down on the bed and mistaken for a male escort the moment he meets the guy. As his luck continues to worsen, Tsuya loses his wallet and is forced to stay with Chihiro for a week until his schedule calms down enough to go back with him to the countryside to write the songs they need. When they finally arrive, Kuno realizes they’ve got a lot of work to do if they want to whip that singing group into shape.

(Source: Futekiya)

117210.description:
Designer Tohru finds himself drawn to Yurihara, the new part-timer at a gardening shop near his workplace. Tohru decides to shoot his shot because Yurihara reminds him of his ideal partner, a younger guy he once used to date, but all his attempts at flirting are met with Yurihara's bluntness and frank rejection. It looks like there's no hope left for Tohru...until he bumps into Yurihara dead drunk on the sidewalk!

(Source: Futekiya)

117211.description:
Sawada can't take his eyes off of Tsuji, a quiet classmate who seems to have been closing himself off to everyone. One day, Sawada bumps into Tsuji and touches the cut on his finger, but Tsuji...moans?? It turns out the reason why Tsuji's been isolating himself because he's hyper-sensitive to other people's touches, so Sawada comes up with a plan: get Tsuji used to touching others, by touching him! With careful after-school practice, Tsuji gets used to touching Sawada's fingers, hands, arms... but how about his heart?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

117212.description:
One day, high school teacher Yoshitake finds a 60's era paper left in the school's old building. Written there are the names Yosuke Haruoki, writer of a short story, and Mikumo Sakagami, the short story's main character. Through an array of strange coincidences, Yoshitake and his colleague, Yahiro, begin to have the strangest hunch: that Haruoki and Sakagami were their past lives.

(Source: Futekiya)

117213.description:
College student Sano, who is curious about love but has never felt it, decides to go to associate professor Kigami, who's famous for doling love advice out to his students. When he's mistaken for a part-time assistant, however, Sano gets roped into cleaning the Archaeology department's room for Kigami instead. Impressed by his work, Kigami gives him advice in exchange for his trouble and suggests Sano be his teacher's assistant for real. But would his advice still successfully snag Sano a girlfriend, even though Kigami's only ever liked guys?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

117214.description:
Tsubura Kureha, who is at the top position of my class ended up seeing the collection of love comedy movie ideas that i, Funakura Shizuma a movie otaku, have been writing in secret.
Shizuma was prepared to get demoted from just an asocial person to a fiction loving otaku, however, kureha instead chose to tell him her secret.
「You know, i.... i'm drawing BL manga!」
Kureha who is kind of a big shot in the BL world is asking Shizuma for guidance on creating a love comedy and to help her, who was deeply impressed by his work, with her professional debut. However her knowledge on love between men and women is so lacking, that she even went as far as to ask him out for a "simulated relationship".
This is the start of a love comedy between a secret otaku and a riajuu girl!

title.native: シャアとアムロと老いと ー安らぎの地平へー
title.romaji: Char to Amuro to Oi to: Yasuragi no Chihei e

117255.description:
The light you took from me, my mind trembling in darkness.
A yuri anthology featuring five stories on the theme of Jealousy.

1. Hekireki ni Nite (霹靂に似て) by ヨルモ
2. Mikoto ka Inaito to Uni mo Kimasu (みよ子がいないとどうにもきまずい！) by 金魚鉢でめ
3. Ai Nante Shiranai (アイなんて知らない) by みかん氏
4. Ano Sugata o Oimotomete (あの姿を追い求めて) by 目玉焼き
5. Night Queen by 空倉シキシ

Also includes the short story Bleu Marionette by cover artist 切符.

117256.description:
Your light shines on me, my feelings reflected so bright and vividly.
A yuri anthology on the theme of Envy.

1. Junjou no Katen (純情のカーテン) by さかもとびん
2. My Kitten by 海島千本
3. Momo to Rin (桃と凛) by もし
4. Shiawasena Yoru (幸せな夜) by 目玉焼き
5. Rainy Emotion (レイニーエモーション) by 桐山はるか

Also includes the short story Bleu Étoile by cover artist 切符.

117258.description:
Goblin Slayer Gaiden 2: Tsubanari no Daikatana is a spin-off series of the main Goblin Slayer! light novel. This is the first manga adaptation of the light novel.

Set 10 years prior to the original series, the story centers around Sword Maiden's party of six adventurers on their journey to the Dungeon of the Dead to kill the Demon Lord.

title.native: ゴブリンスレイヤー外伝2 鍔鳴の太刀
title.romaji: Goblin Slayer Gaiden 2: Tsubanari no Daikatana

1-4. Yamainuhime: Ingyaku no Yomeiri (山狗姫 淫虐の嫁入り)
5. Haitoku no Ryoshuuzuma Teresa: Ma ni Izanawareshi Seijo (背徳の虜囚妻テレサ 魔に誘われし聖女)
6. Hitozuma Club (人妻倶楽部)
7. Senka no Adabana: Operation Decoy (戦渦の徒花 Operation Decoy)
8. The Hunting: Sange no Ori (ザ・ハンティング 散華の檻)
synonyms: Haitoku no Ryoshuuzuma Teresa: Ma ni Izanawareshi Seijo

title.romaji: Shokutai no Yoru Ingoku no Chigiri

title.native: スタイリッシュ武器屋

117261.description:
The Zhou Clan is the most powerful clan in the Northern Lands. The main branch of the family is extremely rich and powerful, and its members live carefree and lavish lives, with access to anything they could ever hope for. The other branches spend their lives in servitude to the main branch, in a state of existence close to that of slaves. Zhou Yi is one of the members of the branch family, and his life is one of perpetual work and submission, only wanting to get away from it with his girlfriend Xiao Qing.

After a sequence of tragic events, he will take up a legendary spirit blade and embark on a path to vengeance in order to hunt down those who destroyed his hopes and dreams of a peaceful existence...

117262.description:
I was transmigrated into the body of a villain? Who the hell wrote this script?! And I even stole someone else's girl? And have a powerful older sister? This script keeps getting worse and worse!
And there's even a divine space and ten thousand worlds? I'm definitely dreaming!
After steadying himself, Wu Ming faced these new developments and continued on his journey...

(Source: Webnovel)

117263.description:
Shu's had a rough start to life, and doesn't think he has much of a future—until fate brings him together with talented young pianist and fellow student Akari Yuzuki, the girl with the "Angelic Left Hand" for one high-flying adventure. But when tragedy cuts their relationship short, Shu realizes he must find a way to live for them both...and realizes that something is no longer quite right with his own left hand...

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: มือซ้ายอัจฉริยะนี้เพื่อเธอ

title.english: Piano Duo for the Left Hand

117264.description:
Gu Xinghe is a high school student with few words. After a mysterious bloody red rain, he suddenly found he became the target of a group of monstrous creatures, "the Death Disciples." Whatsmore, his beloved friend Lu Yang fell into a coma on his birthday from the monsters' attack, while Xinghe was saved by a girl with tremendous power. To save his friend, Xinghe joined the "Energy Hunters" academy that the girl attends, and start training to fight the "Death Disciples" and other dark powers.

(Source: Mangatoon)

117265.description:
A beautiful transcendent Ichika just entered high school but since then, she hasn’t talked to anyone since she’s so shy. One day, out of bad luck the rumored former Yankee Yotsuya Takuya, decided to talk to her out of the blue behind the school and for some reason went to karaoke together…

“I want to return the lost item I picked up. Is he really the rumored yankee she thought…?”
The strategy meeting of 2 people after school drawn to each other “to realize their dream” begins!

117266.description: He struggles for influence between the emperors and nobles, the fight for power between the underworld and imperial court. During these prosperous times, how will the fates of the people play out.

117267.description:
There is a classroom in the school. No one except me can see it and I accidently entered it one night…After that I have to study in that class with my ghost classmates and ghost teacher who all died in a fire. Why didn’t they go reincarnation but choose to stay in the school? What’s the secret behind the ghost girl that is pregnant? I have to find out truth…

(Source: Mangatoon)

117268.description:
Across thousands of years, a terracotta warrior comes back to life! With a girl who looks exactly like his sister-in-law, they fight cirmes and become heroes to bring back justice!

(Source: WeComics)

117269.description:
I, Nagayama Makoto a 27 year old working at a trading firm, am bidding farewell to my life as a nihilistic corporate slave.
One day, tired from work, i muttered the words "I want to die" when suddenly a JK death godess called Hina appeared and told me in response to my wish i now only have one more year left to live. I somehow manage to solve her misunderstanding, but as it turns out the only way for me to revert the death sentence is if i fall in love with someone and marry them!? I, as someone in a relationship with their job start to despair, seeing that, Hina made a strange suggestion.
「I will teach you how love works!」
And with that my life together with Hina starts. She encourages me for work, shows me around several date spots, and teaches me how it feels to be loved. I feel like Hina's advances are a bit agressive but this much is to be expected if she wants to teach me about love.... right?

(Source: Overlap Bunko, translated)

title.native: 仕事で疲れた社畜の俺に美少女が絡んでくるのだが……
title.romaji: Shigoto de Tsukareta Shachiku no Ore ni Bishoujo ga Karande Kuru no daga……

117270.description:
After several years, I had a chance reunion with a childhood friend. The smile she once wore has faded and now replaced by a shroud of gossip. What the heck happened to her?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: The Witch Who Wears Flower Petals

title.native: 魔女は花弁を身にまとう
title.romaji: Majo wa Kaben wo mi ni Matou

117271.description:
The world under attack by monsters that are pouring from the 'fracture'. And the 'hunters' who hunt those monsters are the most coveted job in the world currently.

One day, Oh Yun-Sung who works his hardest from day to day as a worker in a meat restaurant awakens an ability to automatically hunt monsters with perfect techniques and physical prowess like in MMORPG when he presses a button 'Auto Hunting' that appears in front of him...!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: นักล่าโหมดออโต้
Junai Keiyaku ~Tsuki 100 man de Kawareta tsuma~

title.native: 純愛契約〜月100万で飼われた妻〜
title.romaji: Junai Keiyaku: Tsuki 100-man de Kawareta Tsuma

117273.description: The Almighty Demon Lord, Resurrected!: The once-reigning demon lord, Lord Shitian, was betrayed by his confidantes during his critical ascension to become a demon saint. With the combined powers of the Five Benevolent Sects, the demon lord was vanquished. Just when the world thought it was rid of the demon lord, he reincarnates into the body of the disciple Mo Fan. With his body weakened and power lost, the demon lord can only wait patiently as he recuperates. This time, combining both demonic and human energy, he will rise again stronger than ever! Under the noses of the so-called Five Benevolent Sects, Lord Shitian embarks on a journey of vengeance, bloody retribution, extermination, ridding the world of all evil, and ultimately reclaiming his throne as the almighty demon lord!
synonyms: The Rebirth Of The Demon God

117275.description:
I'm a celebrity manager, but one day, I awakened a new power...! With one glance from me, all are powerless to resist...!

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

117276.description:
While his classmates were being transferred to another world, Fubuki is pushed out the magical transport by a bully, Yuma. He awakens to find himself alone in a deep forest. The God that saw this happened thereby decides to give Fubuki twice the protection! Will Fubuki be able to endure his new other-world life unscathed with double the skills in this off-world monster-taming fantasy?

(Source: Alpha Manga)
synonyms: I Received Blessings Meant For 2 People From God

title.english: I Got Double the Skills from God!!
title.native: 神様に加護2人分貰いました

117277.description:
As he thought he would be transferred to a different world with his classmates, Fubuki Amasaka was pushed down by bully Yushin, on the way.
When I woke up, I'm alone deep in a forest. However, God who saw the whole story gave blessing to Fubuki for Yushin's worth.
Can Fubuki who got two blessings survive a different world life safely?

title.native: 神様に加護2人分貰いました

117278.description: Caught with a severe fever, Tobio Ikuse, a second-year high school student, was forced to miss his school trip on a luxury liner with his schoolmates. Four days later, Tobio hears the news about the disappearance of the teachers and second-year students from his school, and it devastates him. A few months after the incident, Tobio, having slowly recovered from the sudden loss of his friends, accidentally encounters one of them again. Chasing after his missing friend Sasaki, Tobio finally manages to catch upto him, but is shocked to see Sasaki alongside a Lizard Monster who attacks him together with the monster. Cornered by the monster, Tobio is rescued by another survivor of the missing luxury liner, Natsume Minagawa, who then hands him an egg before parting ways. Later that night, Tobio finds himself under attack, again, this time by two people with monsters. Amidst all the ensuing chaos, out of Tobio's shadow, came out a Puppy that rescues him. After fending off the two monsters, Natsume once again approaches Tobio before finally deciding to take him to their hideout.

2. Kaerizaki no Daishou (返り咲きの代償)
3. Yoru no Trade Trap (夜のトレードトラップ)

A tiny force is enough to tip the scales...

117289.description:
Everyday is a little bit strange. Everyday is wonderful.

Here in Shiratama-cho, strange things come to life like fireflies.
This is a story about "Utakata no Hibino Awako," an office worker who lives in this town.
It is a cute short manga that will touch your heart deeply.

(Source: Akishobo, translated)

117290.description:
Having barely escaped being killed before birth by his parents, he thinks he’s used up a lifetime worth of good luck...
Sumire, a bartender who attracts only good-for-nothing men, has given up on happiness.
Estranged from his parents, he should have gotten used to being alone... But a distant relative who’s a university student, Yuushin, comes to spend some time with him, and Yuushin’s feelings for Sumire grow stronger and stronger...
A heartrending age-gap romance.

title.english: We will surely have a happy ending

synonyms: Kirby of the Stars: Daily Round Diary!

title.native: 星のカービィ 今日もまんまる日記!
title.romaji: Hoshi no Kirby: Kyou mo Manmaru Nikki!

117293.description:
A graphic memoir of a good-for-nothing Japanese artist who has been jailed twice for so-called acts of obscenity and the distribution of pornographic materials yet continues to champion the art of pussy. In a society where one can be censored, pixelated, and punished, Rokudenashiko asks what makes pussy so problematic?

(Source: Koyama Press)

title.english: What Is Obscenity?: The Story of a Good for Nothing Artist and Her Pussy

title.romaji: Waisetsu tte Nan Desu ka? ("Jishou Geijutsuka" to Yobareta Watakushi)

117295.description: A high school girl that's always beckoned by death x a rich detective, teaming together to solve challenging cases!

title.native: アンクールデッド

117296.description: The story tells of a boy named Izumo who is the prince of Nakatsu a country where his uncle, Furune, is the king. He is a hot-blooded man full of justice, but he doesn't quite understand what his position entails; sometimes his behavior is somewhat overwhelming. It is then, assassins lurking in foreign merchant ships will take Furune for surprise.

117297.description:
0-7. Kuro Gal Kyoushi - Katakuse Amane: Donna Mondai Kyou mo Gyaku Rape de Kousei Shichauzo! (黒ギャル教師・交久瀬天音　～どんな問題校も逆レイプで更生しちゃうぞ！); kakioroshi, Comic Grape Vol.60 ~ 66
8. Ane ga Gal ni Natta Wake: Kane de Karada wo Uru Kuroniku Bitch JK (姉がギャルになったワケ ～金でカラダを売る黒肉ビッチJK～); Comic Grape Vol.58
9. Hyakusenrenma Gal x Doutei Danshi: Natsu Da! Mizugi Da! Gyaku Rape Da! (百戦錬磨ギャル×童貞男子 ～夏だ！水着だ！逆レイプだ！～); Comic Grape Vol.59

Hyakusenrenma Gal x Doutei Danshi: Natsu Da! Mizugi Da! Gyaku Rape Da!

117298.description: On the eve of her wedding, Bai Qiandu received word of her fiancé, Zhongli's death. This shocking revelation turned Qiandu's life on its head and she learns from others that he suffered from severe depression. Was it an accident that Zhongli died or pre-mediated suicide? In order to uncover the true circumstances behind Zhongli's death, Qiandu sets out on a journey to retrace his steps. And the unexpected truth she ends up finding out is...

117299.description: Neko Shitsuji is a comedy about a single woman (Mistress) in Japan living with her cat (Cat Butler). Sometimes Cat Butler acts like a butler but he mostly acts like a cat. This is the story of their everyday lives together.

117300.description:
The manga is set a few years after the original Saint Tail vanished, and a new girl rises to take up the mantle.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 怪盗セイント・テール　girls！

6-7. Minimum Teacher (みにまむてぃーちゃー); Comic Potpourri Club 2009-10, kakioroshi

117302.description:
My feelings won't stop gushing out! Atonement sex ♥

(Source: Fakku)

117304.description: The story is set on Tokyo. There is a rumor running around Tokyo about winning 10 million yen if you win a match to the blind soccer team "Jade Emperor Shinjuku". At that time, Ji-he, a korean girl, was looking for a member to join Brassica, a blind soccer team from Ikebukuro. One day, a blind young man called Oyamada came to the cabaret club where she works. Oyamada, who has no experience in blind soccer, is forced to join to team to match the required number of members. However, this man is actually...

117306.description:
Vampires, a supernatural detective, and a girl’s head in a birdcage, oh my! The mysterious game is afoot in Victorian England in this atmospheric supernatural story that’s sure to keep you on your toes!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: The following chapters were split into multiple parts and later combined in the volume releases: 16 to 22, 24, 25, 29, 30, 34 to 35.

title.native: アンデッドガール・マーダーファルス

117307.description:
Tsubasa, the distinguished son of a famous musician, has a secret BDSM kink that he struggles to comes to terms with. When he chances upon Masaki, a man who meets people with his fists, will Tsubasa finally be able to understand his own desires?

Featuring Hiiragi Chiaki's ex from Ore no Oniku-chan.

117308.description: Asami married Ikemen Shinya because he had a great job at a big trading company. Expecting an exciting life as newlyweds in the city, she was badly surprised when he suddenly decided to quit his job to move out to the countryside to become a farmer.

title.native: おはようから おやすみまで

117309.description:
Isn't rebirth for taking a full control of my life? Waking up and back to high school, do I really have a change to live again? Then first thing I should do is..

(Source: WebComics)

117310.description:
For Yeonsu, writing is all there is to life. Her workaholic tendencies prevent her from properly eating, sleeping, exercising…until one day, she wakes up and finds herself in a hospital room. A clear warning from the doctor about her physical health and a desperation to come up with the plot of her next story forces Yeonsu to seek the help of Gyeol, a fellow patient. Falling in love with an athletic stranger may seem like the stuff of romance novels, but reality can often be crazier than fiction…

(Source: Lezhin US)

117311.description:
A bright young girl fell for the boy with silver hair after being saved by him. But when they meet again years later, the boy is no longer the kind, angelic person he once was. To others, he is awfully selfish. What will happen after the girl comes back into his life?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and one extra.

117312.description:
Born into a family well-versed in Chinese medicine, Han Fei woke up one day and found herself transmigrated into another body, unable to even bend down and see her toes! And then she found out that she was headed for an arranged marriage with the prince in the wheelchair. People made fun of their handicaps. The fatty and the cripple, the ideal couple? But for the sake of his handsome face, Han Fei swore that she's going to lose weight! And have herself a grand wedding!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes three extras chapters.
synonyms: Your Highness, I Gotta Watch My Figure
His Highness, Don't Leave! I Will Lose Weight for You!

117313.description:
First. First lie, first kiss, first love. When Henry and Sam first met that summer long ago, Henry learned the power of first love. But…time goes on, people part, summer ends and so too did their blink of a relationship. All but a distant memory now, when Henry and Sam gradually become close again, Henry finds himself feeling those fiery emotions for the first time since that wistful summer.

(Source: Tapas)

117314.description:
Speeding and drifting at 200 miles/ hour, heart beating twice as fast as usual… Don’t try to escape you old driver, as the sexy cop is trying to catch you from behind! Follow the traffic rules and law, and drive reasonably! Racing is strictly prohibited…

(Source: WeComics)

117315.description:
Compared to men's fashion, women's fashion is more complicated and difficult to understand… But don't worry! It is natural that not everyone knows how to dress fashionably right away. Let's learn the basics of fashion together so that one day you will be able to choose for yourself what suits you best!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes three chapters excluded from the volume release.
synonyms: Do It This Way If You Weare the Clothes. For Ladies'

title.native: 服を着るならこんなふうに　for ladies′
title.romaji: Fuku wo Kiru Nara Konna Fuu ni for ladies'

117317.description: A colossal structure dwarfing the vast jungle at its feet, built by the Ancient Ones - the Tower of Gods. Legends say within its walls there lie countless relics able to fulfill any wish one could possibly make. But for the wish to be granted the pretender must pass the Trial of the Guardian - a fight with the mysterious ancient monster, lurking wakefully in the shadow of the Tower. Few are those who have faced the beast and lived to tell the tale...The stories that follow are about young girls, brave and desperate enough to confront the dreadful Guardian in a bitter fight for a wish that's worth dying for.

title.romaji: Genshi Otome to Kami no Tou

117318.description:
By your side, even till death.

The boy, though born to a king, chose a path the whole world condemned. The girl, due to forces out of her control, was a pariah from the moment she was born. The stars align for this unlikely pair as their destinies entwine, and they form a bond that stands the test of time.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: Starfall: A Song For the Star

117319.description:
Ling Yufei overcame many obstacles on his journey to become a pilot. However, a sudden company order dashed his dreams by assigning him a new captain, who's younger than him and parachuted in above him?! Under these circumstances, Ling Yufei can only rely on his wits on this flight of romance...

Skyhawk Airlines is about to take off, please enjoy the amusing shenanigans of the captain, co-pilot, and their flight crew!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

117320.description:
Princess Enisha’s birth marks the start of the Hyperion Empire’s prophetic reign. With her unfathomably cute face and a ceaseless supply of loyal servants, life is pretty great for the baby princess. There’s just the small issue of her two psychotic-killer brothers and a war-hungry father who she must stop from driving the empire into ruin. Enisha’s got a lot on her plate, between the constant flood of assassins trying to kill her and those pesky memories of her past life. But she’s in no rush to return to being the powerful high mage of a magical kingdom. After all, being Hyperion’s one great hope certainly has its royal perks. It’s not easy being the empire’s beloved princess, but these subjects will just have to do.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 30 side stories.

117321.description:
A talented man entered the palace to win the favor of the emperor for his younger sister. How could he do that under the cover of a woman in the cruel and complex harem? And what story would he have with the Emperor and the Prime Minister? Not only does he have to fight for the position, but also fall in love for his sister. Will he achieve his goal? What will happen after the Emperor find out the truth?

(Source: Mangatoon)

117322.description:
The God of Cosmos was framed and persecuted after he failed in the competition over the crown of the lord. No one would expect he could come back to life 80 thousand years later. This time his soul was accidentally bound with Yang Chen, the son of a servant. Unfortunately, Yang Chen, the original body owner, was the worst at cultivation. How could the God of Cosmos start his revenge planned for 80 millenniums? The answer is, of course, cultivation!

(Source: MangaToon)

title.english: Return of Cultivator: Vision of Eighty Millenniums

117323.description:
"Kitamikado-kun, this is a Dating Game. And falling in love...means becoming a slave."

Mikado Kitamikado fell into a trap set by Kisa, the daughter of the Nanjou family that controls the underside of Japanese society, ending up at her mercy. Following that, he was presented with a "Heart-stealing Game," where admitting your love meant losing.

For an aspiring politician like Mikado shouldering the future of Japan, on top of having a fiancee, scandals were a strict taboo. Their futures being at stake, he challenged the game with a do-or-die spirit, but Kisa's advances repeatedly chipped away at his reason. And that was to be expected—he was in love with Kisa, after all. However, it was much the same for her too...

A sugary dating game of dirty schemers starts now!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

title.native: 可愛い女の子に攻略されるのは好きですか？
title.romaji: Kawaii Onna no Ko ni Kouryaku Sareru no wa Suki desu ka?

117324.description: A comedy about two ordinary high school boys.
synonyms: Nan Hao & Shang Feng the Odd Couple

117326.description:
The story follows the lax, less than weighty daily life of the ARKS force members.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ファンタシースターオンライン2 ぷそ煮コミ
title.romaji: Phantasy Star Online 2: Puso Ni Comi

117327.description:
After being abandoned by his influential family for being an omega, Kisaragi Akito turns to prostitution to support himself. After work one evening, he is kidnapped by several masked men, and put up for sale at an underground auction! Asahina Reiji (alpha), a.k.a. "the ruthless prince" of the Asahina group, brought him for 3-billion yen. Akito thought that he would be treated as a slave or a plaything, so he is shocked when Reiji asks him to bear his child...?? Akito had been through a lot, and didn't think much before accepting the offer... He always hated the omega heats, but ends up yearning for it when he is embraced by Reiji...

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.
synonyms: Ijiwaru na Tsukai no Netsu ni Oborete...

title.native: いじわるな番の熱に溺れて…
title.romaji: Ijiwaru na Tsugai no Netsu ni Oborete...

117328.description:
One woman is on a mission to experience another night of ecstasy with a man whose name she never caught, but whose touch she can’t forget.

Seven years ago, Eun-Seong was plucked from disaster by an enigmatic savior. What she remembers most isn’t the heroic rescue, but what happened next. After winding up in bed with her hero, she didn’t catch his name, but she did get the most amazing night of pleasure in her life! Since then, she’s searched for the perfect climax with countless others, yet it always remains tantalizingly out of reach. Undeterred, Eun-Seong continues her hot pursuit of the elusive “Big O” and the mysterious man who holds the key to her ultimate satisfaction.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

117329.description:
"Because I like him... I want to surrender to these sexual feelings and just drown in this love... But the more I like him, the more my past as a boy haunts me..." Born in the body of a boy, but a girl at heart, Sanae decides to start over as a woman by getting gender reassignment surgery. One day, her purse gets snatched, and Sanae reunites with her first crush Sakaki when she goes to the police for help! One thing leads to another, and she ends up sleeping at his place. She can't help but kiss his cheek while he's asleep... only to realize he wasn't! She melts as he pulls her in his arms and gives Sanae her first sexual experience as a woman. She just wants to forget her past as a boy in the strength of his embrace, but...

(Source: Renta!)

117337.description:
Volume 1:
"He'll do it with anyone if asked, even with me."

It's not easy for college student Shuri to harbor affection for Hisato, a vampire who's been like a father to him, when Hisato will kiss, have sex with, and even whisper words of love to any who wishes for it. Wanting to become the "soulmate" that Hisato has been yearning for, Shuri is ruthlessly eliminating people getting close to him, but there's no end to people willing to give their blood and bodies to Hisato in return for the pleasure they get from getting their blood sucked...

Volume 2:
Kissing and blood-sucking are allowed, but not sex... Why? Detective Koichiro dotes on his cousin Enji, who calls himself an inhuman "vampire", even giving him blood whenever he wants. "If I die, you die. Is that what you want?" Enji, who desires not only his blood but Koichiro's entire existence, suggests it's time for them to grow apart... but will Koichiro accept that?

(Source: BookLive)

117339.description:
Mercedia Sasha has it all: looks, wealth, status... No man is good enough for her, and she makes sure everyone knows the fact. Her single life is peaceful and perfect... until one day, she wakes up wearing a hideous wedding dress aboard a ship in the middle of the ocean! To her horror, someone has devised an elaborate kidnapping to wed her off to admiral Demetriu Cyprosa, the empire's greatest war hero—or massive jerk, as others call him behind his back. What’s worse, they're headed to a deserted island for their honeymoon! Can the incompatible newlyweds put aside their quarrels to plan an escape? Or will their stubborn ways get the best of them before they can exact revenge on the ones who set them up?

(Source: TappyToon)

117357.description: Caught with a severe fever, Tobio Ikuse, a second-year high school student, was forced to miss his school trip on a luxury liner with his schoolmates. Four days later, Tobio hears the news about the disappearance of the teachers and second-year students from his school, and it devastates him. A few months after the incident, Tobio, having slowly recovered from the sudden loss of his friends, accidentally encounters one of them again. Chasing after his missing friend Sasaki, Tobio finally manages to catch upto him, but is shocked to see Sasaki alongside a Lizard Monster who attacks him together with the monster. Cornered by the monster, Tobio is rescued by another survivor of the missing luxury liner, Natsume Minagawa, who then hands him an egg before parting ways. Later that night, Tobio finds himself under attack, again, this time by two people with monsters. Amidst all the ensuing chaos, out of Tobio's shadow, came out a Puppy that rescues him. After fending off the two monsters, Natsume once again approaches Tobio before finally deciding to take him to their hideout.

The story follows Gold Saint Sagittarius Aiolos protecting baby Athena.

(Source: Anime News Network)

117394.description:
Universal Century 0079. The One Year War, which started with the Principality of Zeon's declaration of war, took the largest toll in human history. Their first step, in particular, was a colony drop, which brought unprecedented damage to the Earth and in an instant, resulted in the death of half of mankind. This story depicts the road to recovery of a ravaged land, the hardest hit area of Australia: Ground Zero for the colony drop.

Includes chapter 0.

Kota is a die-hard otaku with a crush on his childhood friend Yona. However, he ends up living with the popular mother-daughter cosplayers Miya and Yuzuki...? A romantic comedy about the struggle to escape from the otaku world has begun!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

117406.description: A world where art becomes magic. In this world, people who can inspire passion with their Magic Arts are called Artistas, and are employed in show business. In Hoshinomori Private Magical Arts High School, where Artistas are taught, a strange new student named Kohana Aigasaki transfers into the school. Kohana is placed on the planning committee for the school's yearly Hoshinomori Summer Festa cultural festival. She spends her romantic school life with six other boys who aim to become entertainers in the future. Each of the boys specializes in his own Arts, and aims to make Hoshi Fes a success. In addition, the boys also aim to be chosen alongside Kohana as the school's Artista Prince and Princess, only chosen once a year. (Source: Official site)

title.native: マジきゅんっ！ルネッサンス

title.romaji: Bleach: We Do Knot Always Love You

117413.description: Takes place around 30 years before the events in the main series, Lodoss-tou Senki.

117414.description:
A four-panel comedy manga that depicts King aspiring to be a manga creator. In the story, King wants to work as an assistant under professional manga creator Meliodas, and knocks on his door, but the one that answers the door is the editor—the pig Hawk.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: The Seven Deadly Sins: King's Road to Manga

title.native: 七つの大罪 キングの漫画道
title.romaji: Nanatsu no Taizai: King no Manga Michi

117415.description:
In this world, there are people known as "Minimum Holders" who are capable of specific "small miracles." A government funded elite academy trains these Minimum Holders in order for them to reach their maximum potential and serve national interests. Once, a student, of great potential named Nice, dropped out. He started a private investigator team with an assistant named Hajime and seemed content solving cases for his clients (which often involve Minimum Holders). A top student of the academy, Murasaki, has been tasked with bringing Nice back. Murasaki bristles at the claim that Nice has a higher potential than he does, but he ends up involved in Nice's detective activities...

(Source: MangaHelpers)

117416.description:
Many different anthropomorphic predator and prey species are intermingling in a fantastical African savanna society! It is a strictly structured society with many rules, such as those governing when and where a predator is allowed to hunt their prey.

One lion, Leon, doesn't quite fit into the role nature has chosen for him. He doesn't grow his mane out, and, despite his physical strength, he shows no real interest in establishing territory and acquiring a harem of lionesses. But the most abnormal quirk of all is that Leon is a vegetarian lion!

His tiger companion (who has a bit of a crush on him), is firmly of the opinion that herbivores exist to be eaten, but she manages to mostly put up with his vegetarianism. One day, the two of them rescue a frightened gazelle, freshly arrived from the capital. The tiger is less than thrilled to have a pretty female food-animal hanging around with them, but the jackals who are tracking the gazelle seem to have some kind of business with Leon as well...

117419.description:
Shiyouji Shunpei is alone in a hotel room when three strange little creatures come in through his wall. They're looking for some human to make a contract with, and they're not really picky about who that human might be. Before he knows it, Shiyouji is contracted with the three annoying little guys, and it seems like he's supposed to work with them to defeat other creatures that kill humans. He meets with another woman in this line of work, who insists he quit his day job to focus on his new responsibilities. Shiyouji is not an especially great guy, but it looks like he's going to have to be some kind of hero.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

117423.description:
The story about a special service agency that deals with people’s previous lives. Whoever sows sparingly will reap sparingly and whoever sows generously will reap generously. No one knows. In this line of trade of ours, we offer you a chance to return back to your past life. discover the origin of your troubles, seek redemption, and reshape the course of your current life. For such a service, we do not ask for money. Instead we desire. a single drop of your tear.

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Xun Zhao Qian Shi Zhi Lu

title.native: 外道王子の楽園興国記

117426.description: Stranglely, Naoki can't stop thinking about his classmate's broad back...

117428.description: Princess Mary is in a foul mood due to lack of sleep. Can a man known as "The Dream Eating Tapir" end Mary's nightmares?!

117430.description:
Alvis, the hero, lost his life in a battle with the Demon King. However, he lived on... as a skeleton!?

Ending his career as the hero who defeated the Demon King, he spent 3 years sleeping, playing and living out every day. However, in order to find his long time friend, Izana, he once again enrolled as an adventurer, and changed his name from Alvis to Al the Skeleton. Due to his appearance being that of a skeleton, trouble springs forth in his near future!?

Protecting travelling merchants, mapping unexplored dungeons and so on, whilst undertaking numerous requests, Al the Skeleton, wields his sword another day in order to save lives.
synonyms: I was a Hero but now I'm a Skeleton

117436.description: Even though cafe owner Mugimaru, is good looking, rumors say he’s a playboy. But that doesn’t stop the pessimistic, anti-social, and overly serious salaryman, Roku, from going there since he likes how the owner makes his coffee. However, one day the drunk Mugimaru pushes Roku down and says, “Since you like my cafe, that means you like me too, right?” What will happen between salaryman Roku and the psychopathic owner, Mugi?!

Let’s let our bodies speak for us. ♪

117440.description:
Kanata is a handsome young man who can’t help but be the center of attention, even when his mind is miles away. Akira is the perfect student who barely talks to anyone. They don’t know each other’s classes or even their names, but they can’t forget each other’s faces. One day, these two happen to meet on a stairwell near the rooftop. From then on, that roof becomes their secret rendezvous spot. Slowly they discover that while they might be very different on the outside, they both have feelings for each other. Is this a case of opposites attract, or are the differences too great for them to ever truly connect?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Playing with My Non-Existent Pet Dog.

117443.description:
Renellette is the beautiful daughter of a Count, with a position, an education, and enough property befitting her status, yet somehow she can't get married. One day, while searching for a marriage partner, she meets a man who rekindles memories of her past lives, a stalker who interferes with her marriage every time Renellete reincarnates! She struggles to shake off the obstacles between her and a happy marriage in this life, but his shadow is always flickering behind her... The long-awaited comedic love battle fantasy!

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)
synonyms: I've Been Targeted Since Before My Reincarnation!!

元カノの妹と付き合えますか？

title.romaji: Hakushaku-sama no Chinoiserie: Hanayome to Kusuribako

117450.description: A certain male met the end of his life in an unintentional manner. And upon reincarnation, he was faced with another world. Given the name Setsuri, he worked until he grew to be known as a genius. Within these peaceful days....he was informed by a girl named Mau, that his fate was to fight...
synonyms: Cheat Magician War in the Different World

117451.description:
Isekai Tennis Musou follows a high school tennis prodigy who is summoned to another world as a hero and finds it unimpressive when compared to the high school tennis nationals. Tennis is the most powerful superpower in this world: with his tennis skills he can crush a dragon with one hit or defeat an army of demons. But the demon king is also a tennis player.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 異世界テニス無双 テニスプレイヤーとかいう謎の男がちょっと強すぎるんですけど！
title.romaji: Isekai Tennis Musou: Tennis Player toka Iu Nazo no Otoko ga Chotto Tsuyosugiru n desu kedo!

117452.description:
As a viscount’s daughter, Constance Grail is an ordinary girl whose only notable trait is sincerity, leaving her with no real options when someone steals her fiance and falsely accuses her of petty theft at a ball. While Connie awaits her undeserved punishment, a ghost appears to offer a bargain. The spirit is none other than Scarlett Castiel, a noblewoman once praised for her beauty, lineage, and undeniable charisma-and executed some ten years earlier for her wicked deeds. When Connie accepts this proposal, she is possessed by the infamous spirit who instantly turns the tide on her tormenter, thus saving the hapless girl from her miserable fate. It’s never wise striking a deal without knowing exactly what you’ve committed to, though...or you might find yourself bound to a ghost dead set on revenge against her own enemies!

(Source: Yen Press)

synonyms: Different World Prison Root of Plan For Paradise

title.native: 異世界監獄√楽園化計画

117454.description:
Evan Douglas despite being born in nobility, was bullied by everyone in his family due to his low mana capacity and even more due to his black hair and eyes that does not run in the family. The only person who was kind to him is his maid Serafina from the wolf beastman race that is of similar age and he is later exiled from the family and Serafina follows him.

But either by luck or fate, after suffering a hit in the head, Evan started having dreams of a place with extremely high-technology beyond anything he could imagine, on it he saw dolls being controlled by some strange magic and glowing windows with moving pictures. This dreams leads him to develop a new magic he calls control magic, that does not belong to any of the known elements.
synonyms: Carve the Another World by Controlling Magic

title.native: 異世界を制御魔法で切り開け！
title.romaji: Isekai wo Seigyo Mahou de Kirihirake!

117455.description:
A man gets sucked inside a dimensional crack and falls into another world.
The goddess of that world meets the protagonist and awards him divine protection and some items to survive, which includes access to the Internet. After the protagonist sees that the place was way too lawless, he uses his abilities to fix that.
synonyms: Where Will the Old Man Who Was Hurled into Another World Go?

title.native: 異世界に飛ばされたおっさんは何処へ行く？
title.romaji: Isekai ni Tobasareta Ossan wa Doko e Iku?

117456.description:
When Therese decides to try her luck at the castle, she’s not looking to snag the position of crown princess. She’s only after the lavish sign-up bonus the castle offers to new ladies-in-waiting. Her father may be a marquis, but his pockets are empty, so Therese needs to save up a nest egg of her own.

Still, other young ladies are eager to compete for the role of crown princess. And once Therese reaches the castle, she’s going to be witnessing that competition up close. The proceedings seem sure to stir up drama; can Therese avoid getting dragged into it by keeping her nose to the grindstone?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I’m the Grand Duke's Consort Candidate However, I Believe I Can Certainly Surpass It!

title.english: I’m Running for Crown Princess, but All I Want is a Steady Paycheck!
title.native: 大公妃候補だけど、堅実に行こうと思います
title.romaji: Taikou Kisaki Kouho Dakedo, Kenjitsu ni Ikou to Omoimasu

117457.description: An ever-righteous and sword-loving high schooler, Fujinomiya Soujirou is fatally stabbed by a robber during a home invasion. However, on the crossroads between life and death, "God" asks him if he wants to live a little longer. Clutching one of his prized swords, Soujirou agrees to a (cheatless) new life. Sent to another world, his only possessions are a talking sword "Hotarumaru" and the sword that took his life, "Sakura". He is also given the job title of "Cursed Sword Master", granting him the ability to bring out the "personality" of a sword. With a new realm of possibilities laid out before him, he sets forth on a journey to raise a harem of katanas, while begrudgingly hunting monsters and helping those in need.
synonyms: Habitual Swordsman's Cursed Sword Have Become Magical Swords Leading to Harem Life
The Cursed Sword Master’s Harem Life: By the Sword, For the Sword, Cursed Sword Master

title.native: 魔剣師の魔剣による魔剣のためのハーレムライフ
title.romaji: Makenshi no Maken Niyoru Maken no Tame no Harem Life

synonyms: The Life of Domesticated Cat Bun-chan

title.native: 家猫ぶんちゃんの一年

117460.description:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: テムパル〜アイテムの力〜

117461.description: Souichirou, who aims to be an actor, is being cheated on by his girlfriend who pays the living expenses and who he lives together with, and he ends up being kicked out of the apartment. The one who picks up Souichirou when he was on the verge of collapsing in the street was a mysterious dark-skinned guy with a player-like appearance, Kaoru Joukou. He thought Kaoru was his life saver, until Kaoru says, "Give me your gratitude for helping you." Souichirou keeps getting his chastity taken from him at every opportunity!

117464.description:
Welcome to a dazzling girl's school life drama, where a fanatical Vice Principal will stop at nothing to bring her all-girl's school back to order. But the delinquent 1st year Jitsuko has her own priorities... which may have to do with a certain older homeroom teacher.

Note: Won the 12th Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo in 1988.

title.native: 純情クレイジーフルーツ

117465.description:
To demons, humans are nothing but slaves. Morioka Yuuto, an ordinary high school boy, is selected as a candidate to be the next demon king. He is admitted into Ginsei Academy, a school for demons where he's scorned upon by the other students.
"...I'll make you the demon king. So... make me your kin."
After meeting Himekami Rizeru, a beautiful demon girl, Yuuto's world begins to change.

title.native: 魔王学園の反逆者～人類初の魔王候補、眷属少女と王座を目指して成り上がる～
title.romaji: Maou Gakuen no Hangyakusha: Jinrui Hatsu no Maou Kouho, Kenzoku Shoujo to Ouza wo Mezashite Nariagaru

117466.description:
1. Senzoku Dorei Paipan Kumiko (専属奴隷パイパンクミコ)
2. Kyangyaru no Nioi (キャンギャルの匂い)
3. Commodity
4-5. Caster Ookubo Mami (キャスター大久保真美)
6. Kyoutarou no Motokanojo (狂太郎の元彼女)
7. Namahame OL Saori (生ハメOLさおり)
8. Sensei wa Mesu Dorei (先生はメス奴隷)
9. Bloomers Dorei Risa (ブルマー奴隷リサ)

117467.description:
Jae-Won is reunited with his old classmate during a taekwondo lesson. But Jeong-Uk is no longer the timid dork from school. Instead, he’s a fully-grown hunk who’s huge in more ways than one!

It’s clear to Jae-Won that there’s animosity between them, but why? And how come he can't recall if they were friends or enemies? It’s all so hazy!

After class, a fall in the shower causes Jae-Won’s lost memories to begin trickling back to him. And the question, “Did I do something wrong?” sets the two old classmates off on a steamy journey to recover Jae-Won's forgotten past…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: ดื้อนักรักซะให้เข็ด

117468.description:
What?! I only have three months to live?! What the hell is that?! The officer from hell will work as my body guard?! Oh my! This hell is so different! Could you please send another guy here?!!

(Source: Webnovel)

117469.description: "A man should only feel sexual attraction to a woman." That detective who had no interest in homosexual relationships, Nogo Taichirou, is now in a big bind, as just as he enters the home of one of his main suspects, Satou Ayato, the bottom of your body begins to react. And it was about another boy! And he was a detective! But above all, next to him was a baby ?! Being the result of your research ...But more importantly, from who is the baby named Fumita ...?!
synonyms: Omega's Case File: I Gave Birth to this Baby
Omega Jiken-bo: Konoko Ore ga Umimashita
I gave birth to this baby

2. Ayatori (あやとり); Comic Shingeki 2010-06
3. Riko no Kansatsu Nisshi (りこの観察日誌); Comic Shingeki 2009-12
4. Riko to Cosplay Yuugi (りこと衣装遊戯); Comic Shingeki 2010-03
5. Bousou Play (暴走プレイ); Comic Shingeki 2010-07
6. Houkago Asoko de... (放課後あそこで…); Comic Shingeki 2009-07
7. Hajimaru Tsuuhan Seikatsu (はじまる通販生活); Comic Shingeki 2009-05
8. Owaru Tsuuhan Seikatsu (おわる通販生活); Comic Shingeki 2009-08
9. Nyuuyaku (乳惑); Comic Shingeki 2009-11

117471.description:
Calgrande is a magical academy that the nobles and elite magicians attend.

A world of magical fundamentalism, where the strongest talents for the national military gather. Yuuma, a genius magician who once before saved another world, died and reincarnated to this world, is now attending this academy for the sake of achieving a certain goal. Yuuma who is considered the hero candidate of this generation was living happy days with his genius sister in law who is also a brocon, as well as with his other sister in law who is a spoiled angel. However, all of this changed during a extracurricular trip to the demon world. When the evil parts of this world bare their fangs against his precious sister, the magician from the otherworld is unleashing his true power!

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)

title.native: 英雄教室の超越魔術士～現代魔術を極めし者、転生し天使を従える～
title.romaji: Eiyuu Kyoushitsu no Chouetsu Majutsushi: Gendai Majutsu wo Kimeshisha, Tenseishi Tenshi wo Shitagaeru

117472.description:
An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Getting a academy where unusual powers go wild back into shape!

The government is running several schools to manage and educate the people with special powers that have started appearing in this era. One of them is the island academy Tartaros. Kaminaga Kamui, a newly appointed teacher for this academy has witnessed in what kind of state this institution currently is. Very few teachers are able to interfere when the students with special abilities start fights or bully each other. Furthermore, some are even trying to aim their powers at the outside world. Kamui who used to be a student at this academy himself, is now trying to tackle this problem head on and is working hard to resolve these problems!

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)

117474.description:
Both of Evie's parents passed away when she was young. First her mother, then her father a few years later. Now, she's lost her stepmother leaving her, for the first time, truly alone. The only thing she has left to her is a letter from her stepmother addressed to Han Jung-hyuk, her mother's first love.
Delivering this letter will expose a side of her stepmother she never knew and reveal secrets that will make her question who her stepmother really was.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 母の愛人〜残された記憶を辿り〜

A plain girl's carnal love...

(Source: Fakku)

117477.description:
Momotarou is a masked wrestler and a descendant of his legendary warrior namesake. Combining the ferocity of pro wrestling with lighthearted gags, this manga knows how to make the wrestling ring exciting. Throw in characters based on famous figures from fables such as Kintarou and Urashima, and you have yourself a recipe for white-knuckle showdown!

(Source: Weekly Shounen Jump Exhibition Vol.1 Catalog)

117478.description: Karate fighter Raion Ryu is so unflinchingly powerful that, during a sanctioned match, his strikes accidentally explode his opponent into piles of steaming meat. As punishment he dons a sutra-infused mask to suppress his horrific might and goes into hiding with his psychic sister, but the two are eventually hunted down by his ex-master and the fiancé of the man Ryu killed. While their modus operandi would appear to be revenge, they follow divine instructions from up above—Destroy Ryu before he can awaken as the Antichrist! God himself has put out a hit on our masked hero.
synonyms: Ryu, Strongest Man on the Face of the Planet

117479.description:
In year X of Reiwa, an undersea landslide caused a massive tsunami in the Pacific Ocean. However, this was only the beginning of a new disaster. Monsters have appeared, but there are no heroes. Can humanity win peace by its own strength?!

(Source: Kurage Bunch)
synonyms: Task Force for Paranormal Disaster Management

117480.description:
Takuma is a single guy who does nothing but go to work and come home. Too tired to do chores, he decides to get a robot to cook and keep house. “Mina-chan” is such a good housekeeper, Takuma jokes that she should become his wife. Mina takes Takuma’s joke seriously, and slowly the two start doing more things together, like having a picnic outside. As time goes by, Takuma starts to fall for Mina, but can a human and a robot ever have an equal, loving relationship?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes: Fifteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.
Began commercial serialization in the September 2019 issue of Comic Flapper.

117505.description:
"How'd you get in here, human?"

A large wall has always stood between humans and the beast people. Hana accidentally finds a hole in the wall and sneaks in, only to get lost. She meets Sana, who pins her down using his large frame. Hana trembles as Sana interrogates her with sharp eyes, demanding to know her purpose inside the wall. She can't escape! But, even though she's been captured as an "intruder," Sana ends up sheltering Hana in his home from the other beast people... What's going on?

A sweet, heartwarming love story, though a little on the wild side! Read on to learn the joys of interspecies romance!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 獣人さんとお花ちゃん

117506.description:
Taku Kinashi's just moved to Tokyo this spring to attend college, with the dream of getting himself a pretty girlfriend and having his first time at last. He just can't wait to finally live alone like he's always wanted. After settling in, he goes to greet his new neighbor, and who should come out of the door but... a smoldering-hot young man with his shirt hanging open displaying his soft, glistening chest and supple thighs! What's more, he seems to know Taku from somewhere...! What happens when a plain old college straight boy like Taku lives under the same roof as an irresistible, exhibitionistic flirt like Mitsuru?
This long-awaited, action-packed romantic comedy has finally been released as a standalone comic book!!

(Source: Renta!)

A sweet & spicy spinoff of Star and Hedgehog, featuring Harukiyo's big brother, Akihiko!

Laid-back novelist Akihiko and his earnest new editor, Aiichirō (a.k.a. Ai-chan), are faced with an unexpected dynamic shift when Ai-chan walks in on Akihiko in bed with a man— and bursts into tears. Ai-chan confesses his feelings for Akihiko, but since Akihiko has no interest in anything serious, the best he can offer Ai-chan is a steamy, semi-professional friendship with decidedly unprofessional benefits. In spite of Akihiko's efforts to keep things casual, Ai-chan slowly begins to unearth the details of Akihiko's mud-caked romantic past, doggedly pawing his way to the wounded heart of the elusive fox he fell in love with...

His high-level kills quickly garner him notoriety among the game plebs, while boosting his stats as he masterminds his way closer to the top. But there's something no one can figure out: whose side he’s playing for. Now that he knows how to play to win, Woojin will stop at nothing to destroy the hero!

Determined to live it up, this new Melissa is doing things her way — antiquated society, be damned! All idiots, prepare to step aside or perish!

117545.description:
One night in Fukui during an air raid in WW2, young Suwa Oto sees her jazz-loving older sister, Ineko, dance to bassist Odajima Tatsuji's music. Ineko later attempts suicide by drowning, and though rescued, is by war's end a shell of the sister who taught Oto to sing, and Odajima disappears. To reunite the two, Oto, now a student, carries her sister's bass across her back to Tokyo. When Oto's singing catches the attention of a troupe, she plays on a US military base and learns the troupe's bassist is Odajima himself, but without his memories.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

Note: Won the New Face Award at the 24th Japan Media Arts Festival Awards in 2021.

Kazumi is a 28-year-old career woman. She's single and a virgin, wears her hair casually pulled back just to have it out of the way, and is very self-conscious of her tomboy personality. But, for some reason, a handsome up-and-coming star at a client firm asks her out to dinner! Realizing it might be her one and only chance to change who she is, Kazumi accepts the invitation... only to find out that the place her date had in mind to "relax after dinner" is a hotel room!! She's uncomfortable with her body, yet he passionately pursues. His lips and fingers press. She falters, wondering if this is really love. He whispers in her ear, gentle yet cold, "You see now? You don't need love to do things like this." A new romance story begins, full of all sorts of first times, misunderstandings, and near-misses!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: I Can't Do This Unless We're in Love!

117581.description:
Ack! I'm trapped in this webnovel, "Brigitte Wants to be Happy!" No prob, I KNOW what's gonna happen so I'll just—wait. I'm not Brigitte? I'm her aunt, Princess Yerenika?! Uh-oh. I'm stuck 20 years before the main plot... and everyone in my generation ends up tragically dead! Her parents, dead. Me, dead. Villain's dad, King Euredian, dead. A-ha! That's the key. I just need to prevent the villain from being born... time to break out some seduction schemes and flirt like my life depends on it!

(Source: Tapas)

Chapter count include 19 side stories.

117584.description:
Two college students with a shared dream and opposite paths collide–will their ambitions bring them together or pull them apart? Haruka has abandoned her dreams of the theater, but finds herself still haunted by memories. Meanwhile, Nao chases her aspirations for the stage head-on, refusing to back down or let obstacles obscure her way. When the lives of these two women cross, despite their contrary feelings, they end up entangled…as romance sparks between them.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

117585.description:
The mystery series tells the story of a man named Ander who was captured by the Demon Army during the long-going war between the demons and mankind. He was one of only 15 people confirmed in history to be immortal. He suffered through horrendous torture, including execution by fire, only to revive a few days later. After years of this treatment he lost his will to live, until he met a certain researcher.

Note: Shogakukan ended publication on Manga ONE and Ura Sunday on October 31, 2022 in response to the mangaka's arrest and indictment on the grounds of sexually abusing a minor. Chapters 66 to 77 and Volumes 6 and 7 were self-published.

synonyms: Full Moon wo Sagashite: Love is Melody

117588.description: Takuto reunites with Mitsuki after three years! But who is the most important in Mitsuki's heart now? After eleven years, following the ending to the series, the answer has finally been revealed in this new story!
