117740.description:
Continuation of 1 Ii ne de Skirt ga 0.1mm Mijikaku Naru Class no Jimi na Onnanoko, irregularly updated by the author. Includes the following comics and more:

1) Daigakusei ni Natta Jimiko to Gal (大学生になった地味子とギャル)
2) Iru Nokori de Ninin Sankyaku no Renshuu suru Jimiko to Gal (居残りで二人三脚の練習する地味子とギャル)
3-4) Gal to Machiawasechuu ni Koe wo Kakerareta Jimiko (ギャルと待ち合わせ中に声を掛けられた地味子)
5) Oyakusoku (お約束)
6) Gakkou Kaeri Issho ni Shitagi wo Minikita Jimiko to Gal (学校帰り一緒に下着を見に来た地味子とギャル)
synonyms: 大学生になった地味子とギャル
Daigakusei ni Natta Jimiko to Gal
居残りで二人三脚の練習する地味子とギャル
Iru Nokori de Ninin Sankyaku no Renshuu suru Jimiko to Gal
ギャルと待ち合わせ中に声を掛けられた地味子
Gal to Machiawasechuu ni Koe wo Kakerareta Jimiko
This Plain Girl's Skirt Will Shrink by 0.1mm for Every Like: After Story

title.native: 1いいねでスカートが0.1mm短くなるクラスの地味な女の子　ー後日談編ー
title.romaji: 1 Ii ne de Skirt ga 0.1mm Mijikaku Naru Class no Jimi na Onnanoko, Gojitsudan-hen

title.native: ゴージャス・カラット 青のカランク

117743.description: Morishima decides to confront a couple of girls that are gossiping about her.
synonyms: A Girl Whose Breasts are a Little Big and is Kinda Pretty

title.native: ちょっと胸がデカくて顔が良い女
title.romaji: Chotto Mune ga Dekakute Kao ga Yoi Onna

117744.description:
After a terrible fire all but consumes Si-Hu’s home, his life has finally gone back to normal except…he has no memories. An amnesiac, he can’t remember much beyond his own name and the café he works at. Then, one day, his former classmate Ye-Seong Min walks in and helps Si-Hu remember everything that ever mattered: they were in love. From the ashes of his life, comes an old flame.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

117745.description:
1-3, 6. Ijimekko to Nakimushi-kun (いじめっ子と泣き虫くん, The Bully and The Crybaby)
High school student Kyosuke despises his long-time rival, Eishi Takano, who's done nothing but make him cry since they were kids!! He told Eishi he'd get his revenge some day. However, one day Eishi took him into a toilet stall and started teasing him and making him cry. To make matters worse, Eishi tells him not to cry for anyone else...!?

4-5. Kizuitara Hameraretemashita. (気づいたらハメられてました。, I Was Trapped Before I Knew It.)

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: I Was Trapped Before I Knew It

title.native: いじめっ子と泣き虫くん

117746.description:
What do an alien, former ninja, weak telepath, and boy pretending to be a girl have in common? They are all classmates at Kashihara Girls' Academy, and they hide their true identities from the world.

Rikka, Chiyo, Sekine, and Tsubasa seem like the best of friends, but they each harbor a monumental secret that they cannot reveal, no matter what. In order to continue masquerading as normal middle school girls, each of them must invent creative ways to conceal their true selves. But that is easier said than done, as the four students end up entangled in numerous shenanigans along the way.

117747.description:
According to the fortune-teller, I was born to be unlucky...was he kidding me?! My child owns the super power that can turn calamities into blessings through dreams! But the bossy president suddenly claimed that he's the natural father of my babe?! And he even kidnapped me and my child?!

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Nali Lai De Da Bao Bei

117748.description: After serving his jail sentence, Yongho is determined to start anew for the sake of his single mother... However, he learns of an existence of a girl who is bedridden because of him.

117749.description: For nine years, I have always been in first place throughout the entire school. I thought that once I entered high school, everything would stay the same. But, someone had actually taken my spot in first place! Unwilling to give up my spot, I switched up my appearance to make my rival fall into my love trap!

117750.description: A collection of cute short stories!

117751.description: A story about offline meetings with a group of sweets lovers I met on SNS while dressed as a woman.

synonyms: Hair Pulled Back Over One Ear

title.native: 先輩が髪を片耳かける理由の漫画。
title.romaji: Senpai ga Kami wo Katamimi Kakeru Riyuu no Manga.

117753.description:
"One day, a popular idol DMed me!"

Suji is an ordinary woman who is reincarnated with gifted hands and the ability to take selfies. One day, a member of a popular idol group, “Chaos” sends a DM asking to meet up. A woman who changes her looks on social media through the use of beautification apps and filters, How will this turn out?!

117754.description:
The lord of the four divine worlds, lord Xiao, was betrayed by his brother. He set up a death trap that killed Xiao. After millennia, the soul of the lord found a vessel, bringing Xiao Fan back to life. Spilled divine blood, captured heavenly castle, unclear fate of his beloved wife - all this kindled the all-consuming fire of hatred in his heart. And now he intends to return to his divine abode behind the heads of traitors and take their lives! Possessing the almighty Dantian, he will open heaven and earth, absorb darkness and light, destroy yin and yang!

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.romaji: Tun Xia Yige Xiu Xian Shi Jie

117759.description:
1. Natsu ga Owaru made (夏が終わるまで); Comic Market 92
2. Natsu ga Owaru made Anal Hen (夏が終わるまで アナル編); Comic Market 93
3. Natsu ga Owaru made Ouchi Hen (夏が終わるまで おうち編); Comic Market 94
4. Natsu ga Owaru made Natsu no Owari Zenpen (夏が終わるまで 夏の終わり前編); Comic Market 95
5. Natsu ga Owaru made Natsu no Owari Kanketsuhen (夏が終わるまで 夏の終わり 完結編); Comic Market 96

Note: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MUDR-050) was released on March 28th, 2023.

title.native: 夏が終わるまで 堕とされた献身少女・由比
title.romaji: Natsu ga Owaru made Da To sa reta kenshin shoujo Yui

117762.description:
An ordinary editor who has only experienced romance through novels finds herself caught up in a complex relationship with the flirtatious and mysterious best-selling author she is assigned to work with.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

117766.description:
Growing up together, they’ve been the best friends all the time, and this is also the attitude they hold toward their relationship at the very beginning. As a result... none of them declares their love to each other even if there is bidirectional crush between them. Being the most troublesome emotion, secret crush enables one to do everything that only lovers will do, makes he grow complex feelings, and also enjoys the carnival alone... He is afraid that his confession might be laughed at, and he is even more scared that a confession would put an end to their original relationship. Both of them overreach themselves in their first love which is full of ignorance, a superficially breathtaking but actually sweet love story!

(Source: WebComics)

117767.description: I was living a life of a NEET, and I was supposed to have died suddenly because of my daily indolence - but when I woke up, I had become a baby. It seems that I was reincarnated in another world where magic exists. I was born the son of a lord in a remote village, and began to lead a second life with my beautiful mother Kara, my big-breasted maid and nanny Ruina, and my beautiful sister Amelia, who is not related to me by blood. As a teenager, I've grown up and enjoy my daily life in a different world using my top-level magical ability and modern knowledge...?

117768.description:
Between three highschool students, a secret love affair begins...
This is the story about a forbidden relationship. An innocent girl falls in love with a boy who has a secret...

(Source: Summer Rain, edited)

Included one-shots: Uwaki na Kizuato, Oroka na Toomawari

117769.description:
A Twitter comic by Hata Knejiro about a couple that will be married in 100 days.

Inspired by Yuuki Kikuichi's first published work: 100-nichi Go ni Shinu Wani.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: These Two Will Be Married In 100 Day

117770.description:
Through the power of medicine, this bedridden, terminally-ill girl will spend the next 100 days living her life to the fullest!

Part of an April Fools prank, inspired by Yuuki Kikuichi's first published work: 100-nichi Go ni Shinu Wani.
synonyms: This Rich Lady Will Die in 100 Days

117771.description:
An endearingly clingy girlfriend adores her boyfriend to no end... until she's at home, where she begrudgingly has to be prim and proper as best as she can.

However, she loves him too much to keep the pretense. Can she keep it up?
synonyms: Deredere Girlfriend Tries to Hold Back
The Innocent Daily Life of a Shy Couple

title.native: 羽津くんと香椎さんの恥ずかしい日常
title.romaji: Hazu-kun to Kashii-san no Hazukashii Nichijou

117774.description:
Short comic strips featuring Timmy, Tommy, and of course Tom Nook with small skits that poke fun at the daily lives of the iconic Animal Crossing business tycoon family.

(Source: Nintendo Wire)

117779.description:
Some time after the events of Gundam EXA, Sthesia Awar informs Leos Alloy that she discovered a new GA data cluster from a computer outside of Jupiter X. The two dive into the new data and find themselves in the Universal Century, during the attack on Side 7. However, after entering the colony, they find that the inside was in ruins, and the RX-78-02 Gundam has been destroyed before it could be activated by Amuro Ray.
The two discover a faint life sign in the colony, the source of which is Themis Chiron, a G-Diver from Saturn II. Chiron warns the two to get away as soon as possible, or they would be caught in the conquest of Mars I.

117781.description: Mizuka, who works in a deli, is so poor that she has to work an extra part-time job to support herself, and she is also plain and has no experience in love. One day, however, Sakuya, a handsome vice-president whom she meets at her part-time job, suddenly takes her out on a date and gives her a fancy dress and a lavish dinner. In addition, an unforeseen situation occurs and ends up living with him in his luxury apartment! The gentle, sweet, and sometimes wicked Sakuya is the most exciting person to live with!
synonyms: Living Together With the Vice President

title.native: 副社長とふたり暮らし＝愛育される日々

117783.description:
Mr.Iruma Kakuya, who has somehow attended a vocational school and is currently hiring. An ordinary 19-year-old who longs for another world reincarnated and dreams of an easy life. He must have made his debut in a different world in a routine traffic accident situation, but it was not the different world he envisioned.
Cheat ability? Harem life? It's good, work!!

title.native: こちら異世界でよろしかったでしょうか？
title.romaji: Kochira Isekai de Yoroshikatta deshou ka?

title.native: 艦隊これくしょん -艦これ- おねがい！ 鎮守府目安箱
title.romaji: Kantai Collection -Kan Colle- Onegai!: Chinjufu Meyasubako

117785.description:
The story of a salaryman's encounters with his coworkers and their feelings for him. Illustrated by Yom on his Twitter account.

Note: On October 2021 it was announced that the manga was licensed by the editorial GOT, and got an official volume release on December 28, 2021.
synonyms: สู้เขาน้องหนูเพื่อนร่วมงาน

117786.description:
The delinquent Kusunoki admires one person - and that is an upperclassman from another school who saved him while he was being beat up; brimming with manliness (but physically small) - Hayato-san. Though large in both body and attitude, Kusunoki is completely submissive to Hayato. He becomes Hayato's underling and escorts him to and back from school, cooks him lunch, and thinks of Hayato all the time when they can't meet. Kusunoki realizes that his feelings are of love through his friend's remarks. Just being subservient to him is not enough, but he wants to do more with the cute and cool Hayato-san...

However, his confessions are always being disturbed by Hayato's nasty friend, Misao, and Hayato himself, who is very simple-minded and pure...

117787.description: Brothers is the name of a trio who use their incredible gifts to accomplish seemingly impossible missions. Not part of any government organization, they work privately for large sums of money. Their leader is Macky Pluto Kara who has a brilliant mind. The other two are HEM, Homo Electric Mechanics, which means that although they are alive, their cells are made of silicone instead of proteins which all humans are made of. It makes them nearly invincible and allows them to have superhuman powers. Rickey Neptune Kara is his older brother and Memory is his younger sister and lover. The Brothers are untouchable, even by the CIA, and carry out difficult tasks for their own benefit.

117788.description: Normal family, normal looks, normal personalities. For someone who is not special, I have become somewhat like the main actor from an action thriller-horror movie. Or perhaps from a romantic comedy movie? No, a slice of life movie? Wait! whatever it may be, Why! Why has this happened to me? The special story of a Korean standard university student, Woo-Ri Nam, is starting!

117789.description:
"If you want your body back won’t you participate in the mannequin game?"
A high school student who was on the brink of death from a traffic accident, woke up to see a completely different person. He was told his mission through a speaker, the curtain rises with a life-risking game...!! If you let down your guard you will instantly die, it’s the ultimate survival suspense!!

Note: The chapter count includes 6 extra chapters and an epilogue.

117790.description: A fantasy romance story about a handsome crowned prince and his companions that are visiting a hot spring village and a girl with mysterious powers.

117795.description:
Set in the Edo period, a young swordswoman named Suzu travels to Edo seeking revenge for her father’s death. While staying at a roadside inn, she becomes caught up in a hostage-style terrorist incident carried out by a mysterious armed group calling themselves the “Tengu.”
She is rescued by “Mashira,” an all-female anti-Tengu unit. Among them is Tsuki, a warrior who cannot see, hear, or speak, yet overwhelms the Tengu with her extraordinary physical combat skills.
This is a hard-edged, unconventional period action story depicting the fierce clash between the eccentric warriors of Mashira and the Tengu.

117797.description:
Hatano Takaki is a third-year in high school who can’t wait to become a “real adult”. One day, he passes by a café and finds himself mysteriously drawn to the proprietress, a mysterious woman who seems to be hiding a secret sadness. Through her, through coffee, and through his encounters with the other café patrons, he begins to taste the bittersweet feelings of love and growing up.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

117802.description:
A manga adaptation of the novel 'One Piece: Ace's Story', drawn by Boichi.

Note: Chapter count includes two special one-shots: "ONE PIECE: Roronoa Zoro, Umi ni Chiru" and "Nami vs Kalifa".

117803.description: Wei Lai accidentally picked up a mysterious camera that can take pictures of the future but found that it only has an effect on her secret crush, a senior.

117809.description: With tensions between the neighboring country rising signaling the presence of a war soon to begin, Soalla, the princess of a small country, worried whether her own country would be able to defend itself with its weak national power. The king was bedridden and the retainers who were her last rays of hope had nothing but the antiquated motto of battle honor in mind. Not one person had a concrete proposal to protect the country, leaving Soalla to wonder if this was where Favell would fall... However, it was then that Naoki appeared before her. A "magician," that left his name in history who possessed the power she desired to save the country.
synonyms: Survival Strategy Thinking with Game Theory for Save the Weak

title.native: 数字で救う! 弱小国家　電卓で戦争する方法を求めよ。ただし敵は剣と火薬で武装しているものとする。
title.romaji: Suuji de Sukuu! Jakushou Kokka: Akushou Kokka Dentaku de Sensou Suru Houhou wo Motome yo. Tadashi Teki wa Ken to Kayaku de Busou Shite Iru Mono to Suru.

117810.description:
2057.

Hemisphere, a man-made city in Tokyo Bay, has wiped out virtually all crime by introducing the quantum AI system "XEVEC", through which the "law" acts as a physical force to protect all citizens. Hemisphere is a "utopia", an ultra-nomocratic society in which the righteous are rewarded and permanent peace is guaranteed. Or so I thought. Until that incident...

Confronting crime in a near-future city! Physical court battles are now in session!

117812.description: The first story tells about how Satan Jacob (Sadao) unified the Demon World. There is also a short story on an incident where Emilia has to deal with a lizard infestation and also a story which takes place in Japan, the winter before the incidents in Volume 1.

117813.description:
By the time he realized it, Wallace, The head librarian of the , had no memory. And what lies inside the forgotten library in the furthest end of the world are only a taciturn maid and that he just can't get through.

And then, one day. He met Lucia, a witch apprentice from the village of the beginning, through a mirror. In order to save the world from the slowly encroaching demon lord. Lucia travels together with the hero who appeared in the village of the beginning. As Wallace is supporting Lucia from the shadow, he comes to realize that his past memory is the key to defeat the demon lord. This is a story of them, a lonely and gentle fantasy story-
synonyms: The Farthest Library in the Mirror
Kagami no Mukou no Saihate Toshokan

title.native: 鏡のむこうの最果て図書館
title.romaji: Kagami no Mukou no Saihate Toshokan

117815.description:
Once the words “I love you” passed her lips, she died, over and over.

It was December 24th, Christmas Eve, and High School Student Riichi’s long-held feelings for Natsumi had been returned. Yet before his happiness could sink in, she lost her life right in front of him. Once he regained his senses, he had returned to two days prior… He learnt that the words “I love you” had become a trigger to rewind time. He attempted to avoid the confession from his beloved but she would always do so, and die once again.

“I love you, Riichi. I love you.”

Trapped in an endless Christmas Eve, will Riichi manage to overcome the recurring tragedy and seize his future?

title.native: 僕と君だけに聖夜は来ない
title.romaji: Boku to Kimi dake ni Seiya wa Konai

117816.description: Dead bodies taken apart was just the beginning of a terrifying, thrilling adventure to take you to the world of Zanmu. Yuta Kayashima, the author of Journey To The West Girls taps in to a new phase of psyco-thriller!

117817.description: Aizawa Yuri has reincarnated 2 times now and is dead tired of being the emperor of this and that. Using his skills he acquired a reincarnation artifact, and starts his life in a brand new world!
synonyms: The Strongest Magical Swordsman Ever Reborn as an F-Rank Adventurer

title.native: 史上最強の魔法剣士、Fランク冒険者に転生する ～剣聖と魔帝、2つの前世を持った男の英雄譚～
title.romaji: Shijou Saikyou no Mahou Kenshi, F Rank Boukensha ni Tensei Suru: Kensei to Matei, 2-tsu no Zense wo Motta Otoko no Eiyuutan

title.native: 彩月お姉ちゃんと一緒に勉強しよ♥
title.romaji: Satsuki Onee-chan to Issho ni Benkyou Shiyo

117819.description: There is a little pawnshop on a hill that's run by a cheerful, energetic high school girl! Shizuku is no ordinary high school girl, though-- she can communicate with objects and help them to tell their stories to their owners. She doesn't seem to accept objects very often, but she regularly helps her customers gain insight into their own life through their belongings.

title.native: いろは坂、上がってすぐ。

117820.description:
After striking a deal with the wealthy and powerful Edwin, Lai is tasked with an impossible mission. He must fool Prince Hector by posing as his rumored lover Ellen, to whom he bears a remarkable resemblance. But life in the palace isn't as easy as it sounds, as Lai is immediately subject to all kinds of harassment and hostility. What could Edwin possibly have in mind as the mastermind behind the scheme? Where is the real Ellen, and what exactly is his relationship with Hector? And now, with Lai in the picture - how will all these things come to change?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: เงารักซ่อนตะวัน

title.native: いつか私は、君を裏切る
title.romaji: Itsuka Watashi wa, Kimi wo Uragiru

117822.description:
VTubers, these online entertainers have seen a sudden surge in popularity, capturing the hearts of millions. ​

But none of them have quite become as much of a household name as Kizuke Yai, the so-called ‘Queen of VTubers.’ Takashi, an average high-school student, is one of her biggest fans. He always tunes in to her broadcasts, and he might even have a little crush on her... Kizuke Yai is the real deal, an actual cute girl behind the screen, at least according to the rumors... But reality is often disappointing. ​​

The Queen of all VTubers is actually Takashi's dad. ​​

The hapless youngster stumbles upon his old man's dark secret, and soon finds himself flung into a nightmarish world of virtual song, dance, and endless cringe. Will Takashi succeed in getting his dad to quit, or will he find himself drawn deeper into the booming virtual scene despite this disillusionment? ​

(Source: Kaiten Books)
synonyms: The Story of My Dad Being a Bishoujo
My Father Became a Cute Vtuber Girl!
Mon père est la reine des Vtubeuses

title.english: My Dad's the Queen of All VTubers?!
title.native: オヤジが美少女になってた話
title.romaji: Oyaji ga Bishoujo ni Natteta Hanashi

117824.description:
Accidentally destroyed several valuable photos, company's newbie Gu YIxin lost her way in the hands of the bossy boss Qi Xinchen...

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Leng Ku Zong Cai De Xia Tian

117825.description: The Koyomi Family once ruled the underside of Japan. Now in ruins, the young heir Kashitarou Koyomi remains, all in his lonesome. Starting up in solitude and having to live with the anger and grudges of others, a self proclaimed caretaker and tutor appears, introducing herself as "Nazuna". It is here, she proclaims, "I will raise you to be a great man of evil!"

title.native: 家庭教師 なずなさん

117826.description:
Sudo, is an unassuming second-year junior high boy, who likes to draw. Kamoi-san, his classmate, is a JC in a short skirt who stands out everywhere she goes! These are the days between a flamboyant gal and an ordinary boy.

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

title.native: わざと見せてる？加茂井さん。

117828.description: Mitsuru Hanahata. Takuya Daizenji. Two polar opposite classmates who unbeknownst to the other admired each other, and it so happened that they bumped into each other while thinking of the other!

title.native: 俺たちの入れ替わり生活

117829.description:
Having been through hell lin the past and given a bottle of mysterious perfume, a mute girl that was born with a curse enters a dream and is told to obtain tears from her tyrannical master to complete the redemption of each other. Will her male master shed tears just for a mute maid?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.romaji: Qi Da Qiji: Wang De Yanlei

title.native: Fate/Grand Order コミックアラカルト PLUS!
title.romaji: Fate/Grand Order: Comic à la Carte PLUS!

117831.description:
This is the fictional story of an all-female German tank squad, which was "lost in the darkness of history," called Schaferhund. They're fierce fighters who don't fear death, and who think of themselves as expendable. They are typically up against the resistance, who will even use children to murder German soldiers. One day, they get a new commander, a young man who values the human lives of the people under his command. There's plenty of friction between the former acting commander of the squad, Kaya, and the new commander--and not only because he accidentally saw her (and many other female soldiers) mostly naked. What will the future hold in store for Schaferhund?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: シェイファー・ハウンド

117833.description:
Maj and Lilica are novice C-rank witches living together in a cramped, single-room apartment. The jobs they can get don't pay much—barely enough for a sad dinner of plain cabbage. They want a better life where they can have pets, buy lots of grimoires, and even eat meat for dinner! It may seem like a long shot, but if they work a little bit harder, their dream life might just be within their grasp!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: A Witch's Life in a Six-Tatami Room

title.english: Witch Life in a Micro Room
title.native: 六畳一間の魔女ライフ
いわかける!! -Try a new climbing-
title.romaji: Iwa Kakeru!!: Try a new climbing

117835.description:
Eko Eko Azarak Reborn brings the terrifying world of witchcraft, demons, and dark magic back to life in this chilling remake of the 1975-79 classic. Misa Kuroi, a powerful witch awakened by humanity’s darkest desires, is summoned by a mysterious stranger and sent on a harrowing journey into Hell. Facing both her dark past and Lucifer himself, Misa must confront unimaginable horrors and unlock her true power to survive.

(Source: Titan Manga)

title.native: エコエコアザラク REBORN

117836.description:
Social outcast Yeonhui dreams of fitting in with her schoolmates. But her social status doesn’t seem like it’s going to change anytime soon -- until an alien named I-an falls out of the sky and crashes into her hopeless life. He helps her transform herself, and she ends up in an exciting love triangle. Will Yeon-Hui choose I-An, the alien who helped her learn the true meaning of happiness, or Han-Je, the human boy who has been secretly protecting her before I-An appeared in her life?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

117838.description: Zu Huaixuan, a child raised in an orphanage, signs a contract with Yi Yang Shigong to travel into the underworld and to become a Bai Wuchang (a good spirit cop) in the god’s army in order to save a teacher who is very important to him. This story takes place in the spirit world that does not only feature Taiwanese and Chinese spirits, but spirits from other cultures as well.

117839.description:
Sexual perversion awakens....!? Ultimate gang rape paradise. ♥

(Source: Fakku)

title.english: The Public Morals Chairman Wants to XXX!

117840.description: Living in an electric appliance store at the corner of the shopping district, Ainaga Kouichi realized a weirdly dressed, mysterious girl standing at the nearby pedestrian crossing. Apparently, she is working for traffic control 24/7 without a break, taking care of the pedestrians so they can safely cross...However, when Ainaga goes to call out to her with a fellow shopping district inhabitant Namina, she refers to herself as a ‘robot’...?!

title.native: 信号さんはそこにあり

117841.description:
One isn't enough! Gimme more stimuli! ♥

(Source: Fakku)

title.native: イヌタデ～京都風説天狗承～

synonyms: Lunatic Hero in Full Moon Nights

117845.description: A cheeky librarian steals someone's private information.

title.native: ビッチーズジャーニー

117847.description: The emotionless agent Alpha was given a secret mission.

117848.description:
In a technological high school in the suburbs of Tokyo, Shinichi, and his cronies reign supreme after having defeated one after the other all the gangs in the region. But for the unbeatable Shinichi, victory is too easy. What to do now that he has reached his goal? Fighting is the only way he found to allay his frustration at having to take over the reins of the small family factory.

As he despairs while thinking of finding a thug worthy of him, he and his friends are suddenly transported into a fantasy world. His fists are no longer enough against the evil creature that appears in front of him. Never mind that, he'll draw a chainsaw. For the villager he saved, there is no doubt that he and his friends are the princes of prophecy, destined to defeat the God of Evil.

Shinichi is in heaven: he finally has an opponent worthy of him.
synonyms: Eight Princes Go to the Teppen

title.native: 異世界ヤンキー八王子

117850.description: Being an adult is a burden. I'd rather stay as a teenager forever. But, thanks to my handsome biology teacher, Mikasa, I'm slowly learning about the adult world?! What will I learn in today's lesson? The adult love comedy, finally in comic form!

title.native: はやく大人になりなさい。

117851.description:
"It wasn't me who was the strongest in another world, but my sister?!"

As a result of an accident in the real world, Asahi Ikusaba is transported to another world. He tries to enjoy the different world he imagined, but his abilities prove to be the weakest. Just as he's about to be attacked by a vicious monster, Asahi's doting elder sister Mayu comes into his rescue and saves him.

Chasing after Asahi's love, Mayu too ended up in the same world as him, with the strongest of abilities and cheat skills. The fantasy tale of the strongest elder sister with a brother complex and the younger brother with the weakest skills begins.
synonyms: One Turn Kill พี่สาวจ้าวต่างโลก: เริ่มต้นชีวิตร่วมเดินทางต่างโลกกับพี่สาว

title.native: 異世界ワンターンキル姉さん ～姉同伴の異世界生活はじめました～
title.romaji: Isekai One Turn Kill Nee-san: Ane Douhan no Isekai Seikatsu Hajimemashita

117852.description: Shunichi Ikeya gets a confession from his childhood friend, Yuka Yashiro, and he comes out as gay. The outcome of that isn't what changes their lives together but rather, a change in sex is what turns their lives around...
synonyms: トランスジッター -歪な外側（カラダ）-

title.native: トランスジッター -歪な外側-

117853.description:
Kaoru Touno heard a rumor: The laws of space and time mean nothing to the Urashima Tunnel. If you find it, walk through and you’ll find your heart’s desire on the other side…in exchange for years of your own life. On the night Kaoru just so happens to find himself standing in front of a tunnel that looks suspiciously like the one the rumor describes, he finds himself thinking of Karen, the sister he lost in an accident five years ago. To Kaoru’s surprise, he’s been followed by the new transfer student Anzu Hanashiro, who promises to help him experiment with the mysterious tunnel–but what does she want from Kaoru in exchange? And what will he have left to give, after the tunnel’s done with him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)
synonyms: คำจากลาของคิมหันต์ ณ ปลายอุโมงค์

title.english: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes
title.native: 夏へのトンネル、さよならの出口
title.romaji: Natsu e no Tunnel, Sayonara no Deguchi

117854.description:
"Kai Aoyama is 40 years old and single. She thought she died the day she was hit by a train, but instead herself reborn as a high schooler in the world of her favorite manga, City Hunter. Lost with no where to go, she heads to a message board in Shinjuku, and frantically scribbles the letters, ""XYZ"". From here, her new life begins with Ryo and Kai in the world of City Hunter!"

(Source: MangaPlaza, edited)
synonyms: ตั้งแต่วันนี้จะเป็น "ซิตี้ฮันเตอร์"

title.english: CITY HUNTER: FROM TODAY, CITY HUNTER

117855.description: I just learnt a love spell. Can I test it on you?
synonyms: The Striking Mage and The Maverick Hero

title.native: ぽんこつ魔術師とマイペースな勇者。
title.romaji: Ponkotsu Majutsushi to Maipeisu na Yuusha.

117856.description: Alternative ending where Kyousuke and Ayase end up together.
synonyms: My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute: Ayase if

title.native: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない あやせif
title.romaji: Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai: Ayase if

117857.description:
Kasumi and Kyousuke are polar opposites when it comes to personality. Kasumi is reserved, soft-spoken and shy; Kyousuke is energetic and has always been popular among their peers. As the saying goes though, opposites have a tendency to attract, and these two have been fast friends since elementary school. To Kasumi, Kyousuke has always been a hero to look up to, someone who supports him and saves him from the bullies. But now, school is over; their relationship suddenly becomes a lot less simple to describe. Facing the world—and one another—as adults, both men find there are things they struggle to say out loud, even to each other.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: I Can't Say Anything To You

title.english: There Are Things I Can't Tell You
title.native: キミに言えないことがある
title.romaji: Kimi ni Ienai Koto ga Aru

117859.description: Honourable mention of Magapoke's 103rd Newcomer Manga Awards.

title.native: 野村ナオと京極ヒナは
title.romaji: Nomura Nao to Kyougoku Hina wa

117860.description:
1-4. Hump Bang Side
5-8. GuKeGuTe Side
9. GuTeGuTe

synonyms: Today My Little Sister Takes the Lead

117867.description:
In middle school, Watabe Fuyuhiko was a top student in grades and sports, and he was looking forward to a glorious high school life. Unfortunately, three idiots stand in his way. Morino Koharu is obsessed with studying, and surpasses Watabe in academics, but she's utterly clueless about everything else. Saotome Akira is constantly exercising, and surpasses Watabe in sports, but her self-worth is tied up with her skill in sports. Izumi Chinatsu, on the other hand, is an all-around failure that simply gets in Watabe's way. Watabe interacts with Morino and Saotome to learn their secrets, and ends up paired with Izumi against his wishes. The three girls are all lonely and friendless, and interpret his interactions as friendly overtures. It looks like Watabe's school life is going to be very different than he imagined!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: 渡る世間はバカばかり

117868.description: The strange cohabitation between Ai, an android, and Siyoon, a normal NEET, begins. Although Ai is always going around causing a commotion, Siyoon slowly starts to warm up to him as Ai starts to become more and more human-like.

117869.description: Side story to Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance.

title.native: 精霊使いの剣舞 精霊舞踏祭
title.romaji: Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance: Elemental Festa

title.native: 宅配恥女～縛られて運ばれる

synonyms: I want her even as a demon

title.native: 俺はアクマでも彼女が欲しい
title.romaji: Ore wa Akuma demo Kanojo ga Hoshii

117872.description:
Tooru has just moved in with his relatives: a mother, grandmother, 3rd year grade schooler, 1st year high schooler (just like Tooru), and 2nd year college student...all girls! Unfortunately for Tooru, the welcoming feast they serve him has salmon roe in everything, and Tooru hates salmon roe. But he can't just come out and say that...so he takes a bite. He quickly sneaks away to the bathroom to rinse away the taste, only to discover that he's become invisible!

Tooru uses this power just like you'd expect any curious teenage boy constantly surrounded by girls would: to spy on them. Follow the numerous adventures of the invisible boy.

117873.description: A unique space has appeared in Tokyo, commonly known as the "24th Ward." Common sense and physical laws do not apply there, so it was deemed a danger zone and was promptly closed. However, when Kosuke infiltrates the 24th ward in search of his missing younger brother, he meets a mysterious girl named Hanako-san. At first, Kosuke rejects the elusive Hanako, but is gradually attracted to the 24th Ward... and Hanako! Delve into the mystery surrounding the 24th ward in this boy meets girl fantasy!

117874.description:
Valerie thought she’d be a genius mage in this world. But when her magic can’t get past basic and her teacher shares a prophecy of a tiger coming to attack(!!), she opts to enjoy an ordinary life. Everything’s fine until she’s engaged to none other than Duke Kylus Dwello. It’s just one thing after another—the mysterious Serena, the servants who ship the duke and Serena, a prince who doesn’t understand boundaries, and even the duke looming over her bed! Can she get back to her nice, quiet life?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Stereotypical Life of a Reincarnated Lady
ชีวิตเรียบง่ายของหญิงสาวผู้กลับชาติมาเกิด
ありふれた転生女子の事情

title.english: A Common Story of a Lady's New Life

117875.description:
Rui is a rope artist who works in the adult industry. Rui does not have good luck with his friends-with-benefits. Rui is horny. Rui's fantasy is to meet a man who is sexy and just beefy enough with a lonely air behind his downcast eyes. But for him, it was just that: a fantasy. So will he believe his luck when the man of his dreams comes knocking at the door, asking for Rui? And what's more: this hunky, well- built dream man (named Shin Natori) has to stay with Rui for the indefinite future...! Rui can't sleep... But maybe he shouldn't, considering Natori is on the run from a dangerous yakuza boss! What kind of business has Rui been roped into!?

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: May I Tie Up the Yakuza
title.native: ヤクザを縛っていいですか？
title.romaji: Yakuza wo Shibatte Ii desu ka?

117877.description:
In a world where Omegas rule supreme, it’s tough being an Alpha. But Hyeon-oh’s been able to lead a decent, if a little boring, life so far and it seems like things'll stay that way. He’ll graduate from university, get a job as a reporter, meet an Omega who’ll take care of him, start a family with them and live happily ever after. The perfect romance. The kind of romance that starts when you ask the bartender to make a drink for the only other person in the bar. Little does Hyeon-oh know how that innocent gesture will pull him headfirst into the most unromantic of situations...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue, an extra scene included in one of the author note's and 10 extra chapters.

117879.description:
Niwa Tasuku working at Sanden Printing Company for 2 years now but still can't get along at all with with Yukino Tsumugi, a female colleague at the DTP temperament. Their colleagues try to 'break the ice' by inviting them out for drinks but later that night, they ended up in a love hotel. A strange "connection" is made between these two, one that would 'link' them during the most private thoughts and moments!

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)

synonyms: Because it seems to be cat day
Neko no Hi Rashii no de

117881.description:
Akari, was plagued by a strange sleepiness that attacked day and night, and ghosts appearing in dreams. However, the evil spirits in the dreams gradually reveal their murderous intent and approach the light ...?

The masterpiece horror suspense series that the inspirational cat Shiro helps the light that attracts the spirit for some reason and leads to the clue of the case resolution.

title.native: あかりとシロの心霊夜話
title.romaji: Akari to Shiro no Shinrei Yawa

117882.description:
Short manga from Migihara's Twitter.

Volume 1: The Lonely Spirit of the Spring
Volume 2: Angel
Volume 3: Assorted stories
Volume 4: Ta-kun and Ko-chan

title.native: さびしがり屋の泉の精
title.romaji: Sabishii Ya no Izumi no Sei

117883.description:
In the future, an app debuts that can simulate your romance with a partner of your choosing and calculate the compatibility score. Is this a way to have a romance that never fails? What is it that people look for in a romance anyway?

An engagement romcom manga about a pessimistic manga artist & his beautiful but mysterious assistant.

117884.description:
Nagi Shinonome, a college student who loves reading erotic novels in sports newspapers, met with his admired erotic novelist, Tatsuo Shidou. Shidou treats him like a child and swears that he could make him cum with just a kiss. And it turns out, Shidou's kiss technique was truly outstanding!!! Since the first day that they met, they went as far as intercrural sex, and Shidou even utilized it to produce a story which got him a new serialization!

"Be my assistant and cooperate with me to produce the story, perverted brat."
"Stop calling me a brat, old man!"

From intercrural sex to 69ing, Shidou's mature adult's way of erotic advancement is giving Nagi even more expectations instead!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Included one-shot: Nayameru Peeping Tom

117885.description: One Shot from The Epic Illustrated magazine.

117886.description:
Like other office workers, Kawashima wakes up, goes to work, goes home, and relieves the stress that built up throughout the day. But, while his colleagues are out drinking and eating together, Kawashima goes home, opens his laptop, and turns on his camera. Every night, Kawashima streams himself as he touches and pleasures himself for adoring fans. Little does Kawashima know, one of his fans might know him beyond the screen... This volume also contains Memories of a True Ending and The Old Man and the Demon, short stories about couples who find love (or just lust?).

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: Do Something You Should Not Do Please
title.native: いけないことをしてくれ

117887.description:
"Senpai, clear this game for me!" Completely out of the blue, high schooler and game otaku Kengo is approached by a handsome junior, Miyuki. "What does an extrovert like him want with me?!" When Miyuki suddenly invites himself into Kengo's home, the older boy is on his guard. But despite being tall and incredibly attractive, Miyuki cries at horror games and is as friendly as a little puppy, and Kengo can't help gradually warming up to him. One day, Kengo discovers that Miyuki is actually an innocent virgin who doesn't even know how to masturbate!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

117888.description:
Dusty pink hair, red piercings, and a beauty mark at the corner of the mouth. Saneatsu is in love with a book character named Hotaru. One day after class, while he's sleeping in the library, Saneatsu wakes up to see a perfect copy of the character he's head over heels for in the form of Nao. The guy's just a little slutty, much like Hotaru. Saneatsu's putty in Nao's hands for his resemblance to Hotaru. But, he soon realizes he doesn't know anything about Nao himself...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

117889.description: When a mysterious boy who always holds a black book in his hands sleeps he dreams grotesque things.
synonyms: I, The Nightmares, and My Big Sisters

title.native: 僕と悪夢とおねえさん

117890.description:
In order to ensure the protection of a 14-year-old girl stuck in a succession war between Mafia clans and other powerful conglomerates, the serious inspector Hatori is forced to collaborate with the whimsical Kuroumaru Wakatsuki, a legendary assassin, known under the name of "Black Dog."

Will this poorly matched duo get along enough to pull young Mana from the clutches of the horde of killers on his heels?

Thus begins an infernal chase on the trail of the most fearsome assassins in the world!

117891.description:
Yu Ha-Na has a trauma related to murder. She then witnesses the new teacher's murder scene.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

117892.description:
Those girls aren't family! They're gold diggers! I'm not gonna let them mess with me.

(Source: Toomics)

title.native: イエスタデイをうたって afterword

117895.description: A silent one-shot consisting of seven different stories.

117896.description:
Once upon a time, a Demon King named Rchimedes caused havoc and destruction in the Human World. He was sealed away by the great hero Creasion, and peace returned to the world.

1000 years later, Rchimedes has returned, a hole has opened up in the Human World, and countless monsters have sprung up. To prevent any further destruction, the King calls upon all 75 (probable) descendants of Creasion.

This story focuses on the adventures of descendant number 45, Alba, and the royal soldier appointed to assist him, Ross.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

117897.description: A young man creates a sex tape with his aggressive girlfriend. His friends end up seeing the tape and decide to try him out as well.
synonyms: 舔一会歇一会的愉快做爱

title.native: べろべろゆるゆるたのしいせっくす
title.romaji: Bero Bero Yuru Yuru Tanoshii Sex

117898.description:
Cursed by God to live out nine wretched lifetimes as a human on Earth, Valentine has finally reached the ninth and final chapter of this long punishment. Reborn as a penniless kid living on the streets, "Lucien" must find a way to survive... But it seems even with eight lives' worth of experience, there are still mistakes to be made! In a tumultuous twist of destiny, could this miserable life lead to... a forbidden romance?

(Source: Tappytoon)

117899.description:
Hijiri Matsubase finally quits the police force and fulfils his dream of running his own detective agency. However, life isn't smooth sailing as it seems and the poor guy is in massive debt after getting scammed. Luckily, or unluckily for Matsubase... Aketoyo, the son of a billionaire reaches out to him for a deal. "Entertain me, I'll pay you $100,000 per case." A deal with the devil can be oh so enticing.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: One Room of Happiness Spin-off - The Corrupt Detective
Pokój w kolorach szczęścia. Genialny detektyw Matsubase

title.native: 幸色のワンルーム　外伝　正壊の名探偵
title.romaji: Sachi-iro No One Room Gaiden: Seikai No Meitantei

117902.description: In an alternate history vision of World War II, featuring witches and magic, a soldier happens upon a witch's shop and hires her to help improve his racecar, despite pushback from the military forces he works under.

117903.description:
52-year-old serious civil servant Kenzaburo Tondenbayashi finds himself in a bizarre situation after a traffic accident. He awakens to discover he's been reincarnated as the haughty daughter of the Auvergne family, Grace, in an otome game set in a magical academy! This promising new series placed 4th in the Next Manga Awards 2020 comic category. Prepare for a hilarious and unpredictable journey!

(Source: Emaqi)
synonyms: The Old Man Reincarnated as a Villainess
中年大叔轉生反派千金

title.english: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
title.native: 悪役令嬢転生おじさん

117904.description: The short tale of those who wait for springtime.

117905.description: Individuals who accumulate stress and transform into slime-like humanoid creatures. Will these sufferers "survive" or "perish"? A human drama begins now, sharply depicting the "way of life" of individuals teetering on the edge of becoming slime-like beings, facing the choice between life and death.

117907.description: After a breakup, Nanami swore off men and concentrated on her work. But after a night of drinking, she woke up in the bed of her handsome co-worker Sakuma. And he wants Nanami to be his "fake" girlfriend!

117908.description:
Affection, betrayal, desperation—love between grown-ups is never a rational thing. Sayaka, age 35, has lived with the perfect husband for ten years. Perfect, that is, except for his disinterest in raising a child—she wants one badly, but just can’t come clean to him about it. Instead she unloads her frustrations on her younger friend Rui at their favorite bar. They trust each other enough to talk about almost anything—but Rui has a secret she can’t even let Sayaka know about!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Guilty: The Silent Firefly Gets Burned

title.native: ギルティ　～鳴かぬ蛍が身を焦がす～
title.romaji: Guilty: Nakanu Hotaru ga Mi wo Kogasu

117909.description:
Liliana Pence's world as a naive, young noblewoman changes upon meeting Edward Carter, a commoner with an agenda of his own. Oblivious to his scorn for her, Liliana dreams of being together with him, until her dreams are shattered by her arranged marriage. Desperate to avoid the union, she confesses to Edward, only to have him coldly reject her and disappear. When Liliana's fortunes take a turn for the worse and she loses everything, the two reunite... but in a way neither expects.

(Source: Tapas)

117910.description: It takes place after the original ending and focuses on Shana and Yuuji in new world Xanadu.

title.native: 灼眼のシャナ クィディティ

117911.description:
"A love triangle between me, my boyfriend Eisuke, and his future self!? Future-Eisuke tells us that we need to break up right away and kisses me... What's going on here!?" On the day of her high school graduation, Chisaki agrees to marry her 18-year-old boyfriend Eisuke, and the two start living together. Just when the happy couple is about to start their new life, a 28-year-old Eisuke from 10 years in the future suddenly appears! The only thing future-Eisuke can remember is that he needs to make the couple break up... So, he kisses Chisaki and snuggles up to her, using his mature charm to seduce her. Could this 28-year-old sweet-talker and Chisaki's straight-laced 18-year-old boyfriend really be the same person!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Two Boyfriends: 18-Year-Old Eisuke and 28-Year-Old Eisuke
title.native: 2人の彼氏～18歳の瑛介と28歳の瑛介
title.romaji: Futari no Kareshi: 18-sai no Eisuke to 28-sai no Eisuke

117912.description: A biographical story about the struggles of being sent to an unfamiliar world without any special abilities or superpowers. Illustrated by Mizukami on behalf of his friend Bucket.

title.native: 異世界エッセイ 作・バケツ

117914.description: Furusawa Hiyori's all-girl boarding school decided to admit top male students to improve its standing. Out of curiosity, Hiyori snuck into the brand new boys dorm only to get caught by the dorm's head boy Chino Chinobu, who wonders if she's some kind of pervert? A forbidden student dorm love story!

title.native: ハニーマスタードミトリー

117915.description:
Leading a life without any inconveniences, the prominent Amamiya household’s heir, Amamiya Ujou, is jaded and dissatisfied. One day, his uncle’s illegitimate son, Yohira, appears before him. Fearing the son might kindle a predicament in the future, Ujou decides to preemptively take care of it. Having been found wan and frail in the slums, Yohira is to be sent to an orphanage. However, fascinated by the boy’s subtle allure, Ujou brings him back to his mansion. Tonight he’s going to… Examine his body? Sensual and stirring, this is the turbulent love story of a master and his servant!

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

title.native: ハイドランジア ケージ

117916.description:
The illegitimate fourth prince, Sugen, thought that his current status was perfect. However, one day, he was told to become the next Emperor.

Sugen, hating the thought of having to toil for the Empire, asked “Why can’t my brothers do it!?” to which the Emperor replied, “They have no determination.”

―And so, the bloody battle of giving the other siblings the inheritance started between the determination-less princes and princess.

title.native: 最低皇子たちによる皇位争『譲』戦　〜貧乏くじの皇位なんて誰にでもくれてやる！〜
title.romaji: Saitei Oujitachi ni Yoru Koui Shou "Jou"-sen: Binboukuji no Koui Nante Dare ni Demo Kurete Yaru!

117918.description:
Garam has always loved to draw, but his dreams of being an artist have been on hold ever since his mother passed away. Wanting to become more independent and focus on his art, he moves into his grandmother's empty house by the ocean. There, he meets his greatest muse: a mystical water creature with no memories of her past. Now it’s up to Garam to help her uncover what she has forgotten.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

117919.description:
Stuck at a low level and lacking a god-given Gift, Allen is labeled a good-for-nothing and banished from the Duchy of Westfeldt. But little do they know, he's actually the reincarnation of a hero from another world with powers from his past life! Allen yearns for a quiet life after growing tired of heroics, so he takes his banishment in stride. Yet his trip to the remote Frontier is interrupted when an assassin attempts to take his former betrothed's life! What former hero worth his salt could stand idly by? So begins another unwanted chapter of excitement in Allen's saga!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Former Hero Was Called as a Failure and Expelled from His Home, Decided to Live on His Own
被称为废物的原英雄、被家里流放后随心所欲地活下去

title.english: The Banished Former Hero Lives as He Pleases
title.native: 出来損ないと呼ばれた元英雄は、実家から追放されたので好き勝手に生きることにした＠COMIC
title.romaji: Dekisokonai to Yobareta Moto Eiyuu wa, Jikka kara Tsuihou Sareta node Suki Katte ni Ikiru Koto ni Shita @Comic

117921.description:
Though Chichi the cat looks very cute, he has one goal: eradicate humanity and take over the world! He decides to recruit comrades to aid him in his quest, but it looks like world conquest won't be that easy?! Follow the adventures of Chichi the ~tyrant~, Dunno, the dog who loves humans, and Kaiser Kang Taeshik, the hard-boiled wild hamster, as they face many hardships on their path to absolute dominion!

Note: The chapter count includes 8 side stories.
synonyms: 地球の主人は猫にゃん

117922.description: Tian Ling, a persecuted young man from his clan classmate, decided to get rid of him in a tragic way that led to death. At the moment of death his blood awakened the remains of a dragon millions of years ago known as the dragon system, he revived it in order to achieve their revenge in destroying the gods and become the supreme master ... in a training journey to seek to destroy the heavens!

117923.description:
Ever since being transported into the world of a book she read, Leana has had one goal: stay on the emperor's good side and avoid being sent to prison! Sure, she agreed to marry him and become his empress consort for a pampered life of luxury, but she's determined not to make the same mistakes as her antagonistic story character. But for some reason, things in the story keep changing -- new characters, unexpected events... Can Leana get this story back on track, or is she in for a plot-twist?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Don't Want to Be Empress!

117924.description:
High school is hard enough without a target on your back, but that’s exactly the situation Kim Yeon-Doo finds herself in when she crosses a group of the most popular kids in school. Marked by the king bee himself, the notorious Ji Hyun-ho, Annie becomes his newest fixation--and he is determined to make her life miserable. Now at his beck and call, Yeon-Doo must stay on Hyun-ho’s good side to maintain her peaceful life and avoid becoming a social pariah. As she navigates her way through alienating social cliques, persistent old crushes, and the hot upstairs neighbor who never puts a shirt on, Yeon-Doo will soon learn that there’s more to being popular than meets the eye. She just wanted to live a normal life, but maybe there’s no escaping these king bees. An official comic adaptation based on the hit dating-sim game.

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)
synonyms: When You're Targeted by the Bully
When You’re On The Blacklist Of Bullies
被不良少年盯上-跑腿羅曼史

117925.description:
Kimura-san wants to get close to her crush Mizushima-kun, but the beautiful and confrontational Hiyama-san has a problem with that... though it's not the kind of problem you'd usually expect from this scenario.

Notes:
- This is the serialized version published in Gangan Joker
- Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 少女漫画主人公×ライバルさん

117926.description:
Kimura-san wants to get close to her crush Mizushima-kun, but the beautiful and confrontational Hiyama-san has a problem with that... though it's not the kind of problem you'd expect from this scenario.

Note: this is the pre-serialization version posted on the author's twitter and later released in volumes by Gangan Joker.
synonyms: ยัยตัวร้ายตั้งใจจะขุดหลุมรัก

title.native: 少女漫画主人公×ライバルさん

117927.description: A short prequel to the Heroes Rising movie included in the Vol. Rising booklet given to moviegoers in Japan.

title.english: My Hero Academia - League of Villains: Undercover
title.native: 僕のヒーローアカデミア 敵〈ヴィラン〉連合:UNDERCOVER
title.romaji: Boku no Hero Academia - Villain Rengou: Undercover

117931.description:
May is a workaholic office lady who is in secret a modern day witch and tries to have a normal life. Due to her magic, she meets a delinquent named Sean who dreams of dominating the neighborhood. Follow the unlikely love story filled with laughs and magic of an office witch and a rebellious man.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Shechu Monu Tan Lian'ai Zhen Nan

117932.description:
In 2755 AD, the latest model spaceship Xebec departed from the City of Nemexis in the Nemexis Star Sector. Due to an accident at the moment of its warp jump, it had to perform an emergency landing on the mysterious planet, Garaga.

The Planet Garaga is a brilliantly written genuine S.F. story that tells of the unimaginable adventures that take place on that twisted world.

117934.description:
Growing up in a rural town, Lee Jihyun had dreamed of becoming a fashion columnist. Now at 30, she finds herself working for a celebrity gossip website with a bulldog clip in her hair. A rumored relationship concerning her favorite star, Haneul, and an observation from a colleague causes her to reminisce about her childhood crush, Jimin. Is Haneul really the boy she once knew? To confirm her suspicions she contacts her hometown friend, Taein, not knowing that he harbors a crush of his own.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Do You Still Think About Me?

title.native: 私のことを憶えていますか
title.romaji: Watashi no Koto wo Oboeteimasu ka?

117935.description:
Don't have regrets!

"Youth" is that part of life that everyone experiences yet admires from afar. I missed the train on that "essence of life."

In that time, I met Iroha, the ghost of a mysterious girl. The youth that I missed began to open its doors to me.

(Source: Elex Media)

117936.description:
Chihiro offers to cover for Tooru at his job when Tooru gets sick.
But wait—what exactly is Tooru's job at the S&M club? Chihiro is about to find out...

117937.description:
In a world where fated pairs are deemed to be a mere legend, Iori (α) still dreams of finding his destined omega. But when he finally crosses paths with him, it turns out the one he's been longing for is the school's famous "alpha devourer", Leo (Ω), who wants absolutely nothing to do with him. Nevertheless, Iori has no intention of giving up. Is this feeling love, fate, or instinct...?

Notes:
- Chapters 2, 4 and 5 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: Wanton Kisses are Keys of Sin
วาดฝันพันธะรัก

title.native: キスは番にひざまずく

117938.description:
A spin-off of the anime series Macross Δ. Takes place 5 years prior to the events in the anime.

After the end of the Vajra War in A.D. 2059, a mysterious disease known as Vár Syndrome began infecting various parts of the galaxy. It afflicted all forms of life, including the once peaceful gargantuan Una-mushi(Eel Bug), causing it to go berserk and terrorizing the local populace on the planet Pipré. In A.D. 2062, Chaos' Pipré Branch, an interplanetary para-military contractor charged with security of Pipré, began an experiment using the female idol group Thrones to demonstrate the power of Song and the power of their "Fold Receptors" to counteract the effects of the Var. Thus begins "Project Thrones".

(Source: Macross Wiki)

title.native: マクロスΔ外伝 マクロスE

117939.description:
The manga will bet set in the same timeline as the Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE anime, with the same in-universe "Gunpla Battle Nexus Online" version.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ガンダムビルドダイバーリゼ

117940.description:
Himitsu no Ouji-sama☆ follows Asahi, who is super poor and has a part-time job. However, one day, she is thrown into the secret world of idols, which is filled with lots of handsome young men.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Included one-shot: Volume 2: Sugar Crush
synonyms: The Secret Prince☆ Absolute Idol Project!
Himitsu no Ouji-sama☆ Zettai Idol Project!

117941.description:
Because of the past trauma, Nanase, who became unable to stand men’s smells, won’t take off his mask even during sex, causing his sex friends to be fed up and leave him. Then, the one Nanase hooked up with when being pent up was a man who had a similar smell to his ex-boyfriend, the source of the trauma.

Feeling his “inner self” has been broken into, Nanase struggles and runs away without thinking. But, a few days later, lured by the nice aroma of incense, Nanase goes into an incense store and meet the store owner and also the same man from the last time, Kei…!

No matter how much it was rejected and pushed away, the warmth that always stays by its side will touch and melt the heart frozen in the past…

117942.description: Deep in the forest where ferocious beasts and magical creatures dwell, a cat takes in an orphaned baby dragon as one of her own.

117943.description:
The June issue of Futabasha's Monthly Action magazine announced on Friday that Azure Konno will draw a sequel of their Koe de Oshigoto! manga titled Koe de Oshigoto!!.

The manga centers on 16-year-old Aoyagi Kanna. Aoyagi's sister works for an adult game company, and she asks Aoyagi to help out as a voice actress for the company.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: イケショタになら抱かれたい

117945.description:
RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Isekai Walkthrough That Begins With the Goddess Who has Zero Followers

title.english: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
title.native: 信者ゼロの女神サマと始める異世界攻略
title.romaji: Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku

117946.description:
Makoto Takatsuki is a normal high school student and a hardcore RPG player. However, “normal” goes out the window when his whole class is involved in a bus crash and whisked away to another world! Powerful gods rule this strange new land of magic and monsters, and every newcomer is blessed with strong stats and unique skills. Well, not quite. Makoto’s stats turn out to be pathetic, and his skills are super weak compared to his classmates’...he’s even stuck as an apprentice mage. Worse still, he’s given only ten years to live! Luckily, Makoto soon meets a minor goddess named Noah, who appears in Makoto’s dreams and asks him to become her first believer. With the help of Noah's blessings and a divine weapon, Makoto seeks to become strong enough to rescue his goddess from the dungeon where she’s been trapped. By training hard and using his weak skills in unorthodox ways, Makoto proves that, even when playing on hardcore difficulty, an RPG player always makes it to the end!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku ~Classmate Saijaku no Mahou Tsukai
Clearing an Isekai with the Zero-Believers Goddess
The Isekai Walkthrough That Begins With the Goddess Who has Zero Followers
The Weakest Mage among the Classmates

title.english: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
title.native: 信者ゼロの女神サマと始める異世界攻略
title.romaji: Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku

117947.description:
The "Hentai" in question is meant in the sense of the original meaning: "perverse sexual desire". Enjoy a diverse collection of fetishes enacted on you as illustrated by some of Comic Be's regulars!

Volume 1 cover illustration: Jake Akahoshi
Volume 2 cover illustration: Sachimo

117948.description:
Special student Hajime Nagumo enters the largest magic school of Tortus to meet new friends, enemies and fall in love with the most powerful vampire in this world, Yue.

Note: Originally published as 18 chapters, was later merged into 10 chapters for the volume release.
synonyms: From a Common School to The World's Strongest

title.native: ありふれた学園で世界最強

117949.description:
Manga creator Takafumi Adachi revealed on Twitter on Tuesday that he has launched a new Animagear manga based on Bandai Candy's toy franchise of the same name.

(Source: Anime News Network)

117950.description: The story begins with an attack on humanity by giant indestructible monsters named "Enemies". The Enemies drive humanity to the brink of extinction... but the one to save the world from the depths of hell is a lone boy!

117951.description:
I was in despair because of my miserable life. This all changed when I met him. He is my savior, but... he is also my worst enemy.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

117953.description:
Suk-Yun is Mr. Perfect from head to toe with crisp creases in his suit, a handsome and fit figure... and an expensive wristwatch dominating his timetable. Woo-in fell for him HARD, because he’s just so... perfect. But over time, the beep of the wristwatch had more power over Suk-Yun than his feelings for Woo-in, so he left. To get over the breakup, Woo-in starts working for a cleaning company and just who is his first customer? The crazy messy junk-filled home of Suk-Yun, Mr. (Not 100%) Perfect.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

117954.description:
Daegun Gal is a salaryman currently suffering from long night shifts and little pay. Then, one night, a devil appeared and claims to know him personally?! This is the story of a man and the devil that swept him off his feet.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes a prologue and three extras.

synonyms: Pro Gamer Girlfriend and Loser Gamer Boyfriend

117958.description:
In a world swarming with yokai demons... One day, mediocre exorcist Kazami encounters a beautiful girl named Paira. But who is she?! And could the seemingly useless Kazami actually have a special ability? Get ready for a new generation of yokai battle comedy manga!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes the epilogue.

117959.description:
The story begins with the arrival of the "Enemies," giant, indestructible monsters that cannot be negotiated with. The Enemies drive humanity to the brink of extinction. A lone boy stopped them with his "moonfall strategy," but he disappeared soon after. After three years, a boy known as Kyle Kamishiro appears on the outskirts of a city. When monsters attack again, he demonstrates the power to manipulate the odds of probability. Despite his efforts, he is afterward drafted into the "Guilty Children," a unit of children who are guilty of crimes.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Published version of the light novel serialized in Young Magazine the 3rd, "completely rewritten" from the serialized version.

117962.description:
In a world where the size of your mana pool decides your standing, Sky, who only had a meager mana pool of five, is branded a failure by his family, despite his noble lineage. However, one day he met a mysterious mage named Ans who imparted his unconventional wisdom onto him. He told him that true strength didn't come from how much mana you had to cast spells, but rather how fast you could fire those spells. What's more, when it came to speed, Sky was a natural. And so, the dropout mage, Sky, began his journey to make a big comeback!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: The Speediest Second-rated Magician – I’ll Get a Thousand Strikes in Before I’m Hit!

title.english: The B-Class Mage of Unrivaled Speed
title.native: 最速無双のB級魔法使い 一発撃たれる前に千発撃ち返す!
title.romaji: Saisoku Musou no B-kyuu Mahou Tsukai: Ippatsu Utareru Mae ni Senpatsu Uchikaesu!

117964.description:
While on a regular school day, Tsukuru along with his classmates got transported to another world. However, at the other side of the summoning there was a hero's auction, where each nation would bid for the heroes to defeat the demon kings of each territories. While his classmates received cheat jobs and got auctioned quickly Tsukuru got the useless job "Chef." As no nation bid for him, he got thrown out through a transfer gate. At the other side of the gate was a territory dominated by strong monsters...

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)
synonyms: Garbage Hero: A Revenge Story of a Hero Who Got Summoned to Another World
Garbage Brave Revenge story of a hero summoned and discarded in another world

title.native: ガベージブレイブ 異世界に召喚され捨てられた勇者の復讐物語
title.romaji: Garbage Brave: Isekai ni Shoukan Sare Suterareta Yuusha no Fukushuu Monogatari

117965.description:
Yuzu Okashi is a shut-in author living alone in neglected squalor. When the neighbor girl Makoto forgot her apartment key, Yuzu took her in until her mom got home. When Makoto saw the mess in Yuzu's apartment, she promised to take care of Yuzu like a mother should!

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title.native: ママごとー小学生ママと大人のムスメー
title.romaji: Mama-goto: Shougakusei Mama to Otona no Musume

117966.description:
Collection of stories:

1-3) Youkaimura no Mitsugo-tachi
4) Kame no Ongaeshi
5) Sugoroku
6) Tatsumaki no Hi
7) Mirai kara Kita Doukyuusei

117967.description:
Sweet treats for the boys who do their best...!
Scatted with the sweets and handsome boys that girls love ☆

Though they love sweets, they just can't tell others... A cool, elite office worker, a handsome band member, and a high school boy who would even cross-dress just for sweets... A compilation of stories woven together by a variety of sweets boys.
synonyms: Sweets Conchert: Sweets Boys of Extra Ordinary
Sweets Concert: Sweet boy's sweet time
Sweets Concert: Sweets boy of Extraordinary
Sweets Conchert: Amami Danshi no Hinichijou
Sweets Concert: Sweets Boys of Extra Ordinary

title.native: スイーツコンチェルト-甘味男子の非日常-
title.romaji: Sweets Concert: Amami Danshi no Hinichijou

117971.description:
Oshimi Kokoharu, 15 years old. She is born and raised in Kumamoto, and she is a first-year student at Ogusu High School. She joined the cheer squad as her club activity in the spring. Now she lives life in her squad jacket, the uniform skirt, and clatters along in traditional wooden clogs. This is a series of school-life vignettes about the smiling, heartwarming, and exciting moments of youth.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

117975.description: Kimura Hajime and Hanasaki Aya went to the same middle school but have never talked to each other. They ended up going to the same high school but will their relationship remain the same?
synonyms: A Friend Who I Went to the Same Middle School With but Have Never Talked To

title.native: 中学同じだけど喋ったことないトモダチ
title.romaji: Chuugaku Onaji Dakedo Shabetta koto nai Tomodachi

title.native: 口は口以上にものを云う
title.romaji: Kuchi wa Kuchi Ijou ni Mono wo Iu

117977.description: Yajima, a project lead in the design department, is swamped with work by Mita, his newly arrived boss from hell. Every day, he doesn’t even have enough time to eat a meal! When he becomes unable to endure his empty stomach and starts having snacks at his desk, Mita orders that snacking during work hours is prohibited! Yajima takes offence at this unreasonable order, but by accident, learns that Mita has a strange sexual fetish that means he gets aroused… by seeing people eat?!

117978.description: A girl gives away her first-ever piece of chocolate to her crush.

title.native: はじめてのぎりチョコ

117979.description:
Seki, who hangs out with the slacker students at his high school is discovered working part-time by the elite student Iwashiro. Despite not knowing each other, they fight, and while Seki is trying to get rid of him, he accidentally makes Iwashiro fall down the stairs. Having sprained his ankle, Iwashiro forces Seki to help him. What will happen when these two with completely different personalities start spending time together?

(Source: LEED Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.native: アウトサイダー・コミュニケーション

117980.description: “Would you mate with me?” In a world where social class is completely decided by race, Shigure, who was promoted to a Holy Knight despite being born from the lower wolf race, meets Kyrie of the cursed snake race Katara in a church and believes that he is the messenger of God. He develops a love for the snake and this eventually turns into an uncontrollable passion.

117983.description: The third light novel of Black Clover, focused around Yuno.
synonyms: Black Clover บันทึกของยูโนะ

title.native: ブラッククローバー ユノの書

117984.description:
The story takes place in the world after the "end" and follows machine soldier Lear, who has been following the "Last Order" and continuing an endless war for over 100 years.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Last Order: Lonely Hundred Years' War

title.native: ラストオーダー ひとりぼっちの百年戦争
title.romaji: Last Order: Hitoribocchi no Hyakunen Sensou

117985.description:
On her 15th birthday, Hinase Kaede, a young girl who was working as a part-timer, perished in a traffic accident. Upon her death, a self-proclaimed “God” appeared, declaring that Kaede would be brought back to life. However, Kaede’s happiness was short-lived and her soul was thrown into Erika, the villainess of an otome game! In the original game, Erika became a saint candidate alongside the heroine, committed evil deeds over the course of the candidacy, and ultimately faced condemnation. Thus, Kaede decides that she will not get close to the main characters of the game so as to avoid the bad end, but yet?

This is the long-awaited fantasy story of a villainous daughter who makes every effort to avoid falling into ruin.

title.native: 悪役令嬢になりました。

117986.description:
Again and again, the story repeats itself, and Ilya is stuck reliving the same fate. No matter the circumstances, no matter what she does to avoid it, she cannot escape her future. Her fiancé, Soleil, will inevitably fall in love with Sylvia, her weak yet kind-hearted little sister, and Illya will be left alone.

At first, she thought she could change his mind, but that only caused feelings of resentment to sprout. She then tried to ignore their relationship, but her love for Soleil never wavered. In this endless loop, the feelings these three hold for one another never differ from those of the original timeline. Thus, along with Ilya's unfaltering love comes unfaltering despair, as she is trapped in time with her heart rent asunder each iteration.

Notes:
- Volume 1 contains a prologue
- Volume 2 contains one extra chapter
- Volume 3 contains one extra manga chapter and one extra novel chapter
- Volume 4 contains one extra chapter
synonyms: Konyakusha wa, watashi no imouto ni koi o suru
My Fiancé's falls in love with my sister.

title.native: 婚約者は、私の妹に恋をする
title.romaji: Konyakusha wa, Watashi no Imouto ni Koi wo Suru

117987.description:
A story between a freewheeling kind of guy and a conservatively dressed and quiet virgin with glasses. “I’ve never felt this sweet sensation before.” “I have a feeling that one day soon I’ll have to tell him I’m a virgin. And I don’t like the idea.”, thinks Kiyatake, who works as a librarian in a local library. He was obliged to allow Sato, who crashed into his place just like an accident faker, to live in his house. Sato looks pushy and spontaneous at the same time...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: รักแรกราคา 860,000 เยน

117988.description:
High schooler Gamou Shouya is a dead man—sort of. The real Gamou Shouya is long gone, but his body lives on, inhabited by the soul of a boy who made a pact with the succubus Armelina. In exchange for his services as her personal hitman, Armelina is helping him hunt down the people who brutally murdered him and his family. The path ahead is dark and deadly, but Shouya’s got nothing left to lose…not even his soul.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: A Young Hitman Between Heaven and Earth

title.native: サキュバス＆ヒットマン

117991.description:
Starmine is a 4-koma manga depicting the daily life of a certain male high school student and nine girls who emerged from his wish to a shooting star.

(Source: Natalie)

title.native: トリアージX　コミックアンソロジー　トリビュートX
title.romaji: Triage X: Comic Anthology Tribute X

117994.description:
The Three Musketeers are back again to celebrate the second season of the Fruits Basket anime! Kill the time between new episodes with the ridiculous antics of Shigure, Ayame, and Hatori! Fruits Basket: The Three Musketeers Arc 2--Start!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Fruits Basket: The Three Musketeers Arc 2
title.native: フルーツバスケット マブダチ特別編 2nd season

synonyms: Pro Gamer Girlfriend and Loser Gamer Boyfriend

title.native: ガチゲーマー彼女とゆるゲーマー彼氏の漫画

117998.description:
For some reason, one day Ohdai woke up with the power to see how turned on people are. He thought to himself "Hey, I could meet horny girls!!", only to notice that his silent and poker-faced best friend's lust gauge was bursting at the seams. Apparently, if the gauge isn't depleted regularly, he could end up becoming a molester...!? He'll be okay if we take care of "it" before the gauge breaks, right!?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: My Quiet Best Friend's Just Tongue-Tied
title.native: 寡黙な親友がただのムッツリでした
title.romaji: Kamoku na Shinyuu ga Tada no Muttsuri deshita

117999.description: For some reason, the family that Rune belongs to is removed from the Cosmos Federation! Left as the last generation of an anonymous family, Rune's choice was to run away to make money while hiding her identity. Rune entered the Moorish family when she was 10 years old and became the closest maid of the lady!
